subject: Weekly Newsletter… and Happy New Year!
body:
Update from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us21.campaign-archive.com/?e=d1c1b9864f&u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=3407b52adc)
---
| |
---
| | | **HAPPY NEW YEAR FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN!**
---
| **My fellow Floridians,**

What a year! As we wrap up 2023, I wanted to share my gratitude through this special video created by my son, Avery Chamberlin. From launching our campaign in January to being sworn in as the newest **State Representative** and now anticipating the start of our first regular session, it has been a whirlwind and also a great honor to take on this solemn duty for District 24.
---
| [ ](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=5c1343dafd&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| _Click to view our video! And follow us on[Facebook](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=b1b35ac0b5&e=d1c1b9864f)._
---
| I am so grateful to my wife **Jenny Becerril Chamberlin** , and to our family, church, and team that helped make this new journey a success. I am honored to serve as one of your **State Representatives** and look forward to the years to come.

During this year we've knocked on thousands of doors, met with constituents each week to discuss issues, spent time in our great community and are now heading into session to work on legislation to improve the lives of Floridians while setting an example for the rest of the country. [#GreatStateOfFlorida](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=cbab151d85&e=d1c1b9864f)

**2023 Political timeline..**
* January we launched our Campaign (Special Election),
* **March 7th** elected in the primary,
* **May 16th** elected in the general,
* **June 30th** took the Oath,
* November we filed our first 2 bills, and
* December wrapped up the first 4 months of Committees in Tallahassee prepping for the Jan-March 2024 Session.

**2024, here we come!**

I can't wait to get to work in the New Year on behalf of my fellow Floridians. Please stay connected by following us on [Facebook](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=846fe07909&e=d1c1b9864f).
---
|
---
| Happy New Year!
**Representative Ryan Chamberlin**
---
|
---

subject: You are not an ATM
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Are you on other political email lists?
If so, you probably regularly receive urgent and panicky emails asking for money. Too many politicians and organizations see their grassroots supporters as an ATM. They use scare tactics, guilt and shame, and downright misleading language to coax people into donating.
It’s bad, and getting worse. Team AOC is determined to rise above that and treat you and our other grassroots supporters with respect. Here’s what we believe:
\- Instead of scaring you to donate, we want to inspire you to take action.
\- Instead of guilt tripping you for not donating enough, we want our emails to provide value to you. We try to send out informative, educational content.
\- Instead of misleading you about fake 5X matches or faux threats, we’re honest with you about what’s going on and how you can help.
\- Instead of only hitting you up when we need money, we’ll also send you opportunities to volunteer or help other candidates and causes who need it. **This year, our supporters contributed to progressives like Jamaal Bowman and causes such as wildfire relief in Hawaii.**
But just like all the other campaigns in your inbox, we do have fundraising goals and deadlines. Everything we raise each quarter is detailed in our public FEC report, and we want to post the biggest possible fundraising numbers. But we’re not going to scare or scam you into donating. We’ll just ask nicely because your donations to AOC are important and meaningful.
[Would you be able to make a $5 donation to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez right now to help us start the new year off strong? We’d really appreciate it.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231230-3.mG3KvT&refcode=em20231230-5563-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5563%2E2526796%2EK5eGTr)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231230-3.mG3KvT&refcode=em20231230-5563-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=5563%2E2526796%2EK5eGTr)**
If you can’t make a donation today, that’s okay too. We still want you here, and we still appreciate you reading our emails.
The truth is that this email list is powerful. It’s powerful precisely because you’re here, with so many others. It’s powerful because when so many of us take collective action all at once, we can make real change.
So, maybe you can’t [donate right now.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231230-3.mG3KvT&refcode=em20231230-5563-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=5563%2E2526796%2EK5eGTr) But maybe you’ll get something of value from the next email we send. Or perhaps you’ll join us for a volunteer activity down the road.
No matter what, we’re glad you’re here. Thanks for being part of this movement,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20231230-3?refcode=em20231230-5563-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&t=22&refcode2=5563_2526796_K5eGTr&akid=5563%2E2526796%2EK5eGTr)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20231230-5563-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&t=23&akid=5563%2E2526796%2EK5eGTr)**

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, PO Box 680080, Corona, NY 11368.

So if you're going to reserve your kit, **[you need to act fast](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jkFvszAMQH-NuYEcOyThkEO_r2KaJu2-05QmZM1KBA10Vf_9BKp29HuW_VyexxQfFvQ_IDqnsAAR8AGIrh_3XG7f-e2lljrXV_We203SfyBaH_Pwt_k80gzZpXGj-lgFyzGgrAYrNHJnmI2pzjYY77sWcTAtkjOKgkeOGmNUAaXwVbKExIJYIEpG2UTRdq2SJ82DMJE7kLj_aVweSvJOLOvdlTJNufFTrkZ7Xtd52cN6oF7Oa7kQbg6o92PyF-B-LT8pAB8FSyGA1KF_PW4jdi2QcjF-LrfTBgxj_QzCekEkjyiqYsN8T-OYFqVB4tfe46f8GwAA__8Ia188)**. For starters, you get 5 meat options. Chicken, beef, pork, turkey and ground beef. So you aren't stuck with 1 or 2 types of protein. And the variety means you can use it in a ton of recipes. Chicken salad, burgers, tacos, you name it. **You're in control, not the stock boy at the grocery store.** Plus, you can actually pronounce the ingredients that we use. That's because there are only 2. Meat, of course, and salt for preservation. That's it! No funky chemicals. No artificial gunk. The only things in your food are food. [**Get Your Brand New, Delicious Ultimate Meat Survival Food Kit!**](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jkFvszAMQH-NuYEcOyThkEO_r2KaJu2-05QmZM1KBA10Vf_9BKp29HuW_VyexxQfFvQ_IDqnsAAR8AGIrh_3XG7f-e2lljrXV_We203SfyBaH_Pwt_k80gzZpXGj-lgFyzGgrAYrNHJnmI2pzjYY77sWcTAtkjOKgkeOGmNUAaXwVbKExIJYIEpG2UTRdq2SJ82DMJE7kLj_aVweSvJOLOvdlTJNufFTrkZ7Xtd52cN6oF7Oa7kQbg6o92PyF-B-LT8pAB8FSyGA1KF_PW4jdi2QcjF-LrfTBgxj_QzCekEkjyiqYsN8T-OYFqVB4tfe46f8GwAA__8Ia188) Now, you may be wondering how we guarantee such a long shelf life for canned foods. Friend, it's Kirsten. I'm about to ask you to **[make a $5 donation ahead of my end-of-quarter deadline tomorrow night.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76144433/446788382/-2054302023?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk4533-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYWZhNTRjYi04M2E3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_UBfPBR9QYCfn4znTQiFPZijyqFdjCXizVU8BlA2pJ8=)** This is an incredibly important deadline, and I'm counting on your help to hit my goal. **But first, I want to thank you — so much — for supporting my campaign.**
I'm fighting every single day to earn your support and deliver on the promises I've made to you. From certifying the Equal Rights Amendment so that we can restore reproductive rights nationwide to fighting gun violence and keeping our communities safe, I'm working tirelessly to win change for your family.
As my grandmother taught me when I was a young girl, politics isn't about parties or polling numbers._ It's about the people._ It's my job to serve your family and do everything that I can to make life better for _you_. | Peter,
The end of the year is quickly approaching, and with it comes a crucial deadline. [This is a critical time for us to come together and rally around our conservative values](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=2170b33859&e=273c9a71fb), as we address two pressing issues: supporting our military and securing our borders.

**First and foremost, let us take a moment to honor the brave men and women in uniform who selflessly serve our nation**. They embody the values of honor, duty, and sacrifice. As a veteran and candidate for Congress, I am fully committed to ensuring that they have the unwavering support, resources, and respect they deserve. Our military personnel protect our freedoms and safeguard our American way of life, and it is our duty to stand by them.

Simultaneously, our nation is facing a grave challenge at our borders. The ongoing border crisis **not only threatens our national security but also undermines the rule of law and the stability of our communities**. It is imperative that we act decisively and with unwavering resolve to secure our borders and protect the sovereignty of our great nation.

In light of these pressing issues, I urge you to contribute to our end-of-quarter fundraising goal today. Your generous support will send a powerful message that change is needed, and it will directly impact our efforts to support our military personnel and work towards securing our borders.

**[By making a contribution](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=785f32eb50&e=273c9a71fb)** , you will enable us to advocate for increased funding for our military, ensuring that they have the necessary resources for training, equipment, and healthcare. Additionally, your support will help us champion legislation that prioritizes border security, enforcing our immigration laws and protecting our citizens. Together, we can raise awareness and engage in grassroots efforts to rally support for secure borders, ensuring the safety and prosperity of our communities.

**[Your contribution, no matter the amount, will make a resounding impact on the lives of our military personnel and the integrity of our borders](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=78b33d6739&e=273c9a71fb)[. Your support is crucial to our success.](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=ae33929420&e=273c9a71fb)**

**[Every dollar counts, and your donation will help us advance conservative values and secure a brighter future for our nation.](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=aff74dcbfd&e=273c9a71fb)** If you are unable to contribute at this time, I kindly ask for your assistance in spreading the word about our campaign to like-minded individuals who share our conservative principles.

Together, we can uphold our conservative values and build a stronger, more prosperous America.

body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMzY1LTg5NjAwMjY0NDU1MzRlZGFiMmM4ODJmN2Q3NTE1NjFmIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjAiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3NlY3VyZWQuaGlsbHNkYWxlLmVkdS9oaWxsc2RhbGUvY3llLTIwMjM_c2M9MDAzOTlOMDI0Mkw1WERPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWN5ZTIzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PTEyMzFfQUVfRkFMUjQ1MjYyIn0/gb0AjeBb1WcR2RtKDE_EtQ)

| | Dear Friend,

I am writing to you today because we are in the midst of a great crisis. And fortunately, you understand this ...

You understand that the anti-American Left is working every day to undermine intelligent patriotism and radically transform our free system of government and our American way of life.

You understand the urgency of the situation as we approach 2024—a **critical year** for America...

We must engage the anti-American Left on the battlefield of education to defend liberty and constitutional government.

Hillsdale College has been deeply engaged in this battle for decades.

**Your generosity helps us to counter an anti-American education agenda that includes promoting radical gender ideology to young schoolchildren and encouraging college students to celebrate terrorism.**

That’s why we’re asking for your year-end support to continue and expand our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

**We must do more.**

With the help of friends like you, who support Hillsdale’s educational mission, we are determined to redouble our efforts at this critical time for our nation.

That’s why we’ve set a goal to raise $6,000,000 online by MIDNIGHT TONIGHT to expand our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** in 2024.

Your generous donation will help us to ...

* **Reach an additional 600,000 American households and businesses with _Imprimis_ , our monthly digest of liberty.** With your support, we plan to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to more than 7,000,000 households and businesses in 2024.
* **Teach citizens nationwide, especially younger Americans, through our FREE online courses.** Your donation will help us to create new online courses and add 900,000 new students in 2024.
* **Restore excellence to American K-12 education.** Your faithful generosity will help us to launch and guide classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

We cannot do this work without you ...

Hillsdale needs your support for its work on behalf of liberty because the forces arrayed against it on the battleground of education are many and powerful.

They are also incredibly well-funded, with Hollywood, Big Tech, mega-corporations, and liberal billionaires like George Soros on their side.

Hillsdale College relies on the support of citizens like you—citizens who understand the importance of education to liberty and want their children and grandchildren to enjoy the blessings of liberty and the American way of life.

**To do our work on behalf of liberty, we need your help.
**
As I’ve explained in the past, Hillsdale College **conducts its educational outreach efforts** —as it does all of its work—while refusing to accept **one penny** of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

To meet our ambitious year-end funding goal, we will need thousands of gifts between **$25** and **$100**. Most of our supporters’ contributions are in this range.

We will also need a significant number of **$500** to **$1,000** donations. But contributions of any size are appreciated.

Since we have one day remaining to fund this project for 2024, we urgently need your help.

**You can safely and securely renew your support using this link:[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye-2023](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMzY1LTg5NjAwMjY0NDU1MzRlZGFiMmM4ODJmN2Q3NTE1NjFmIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL3NlY3VyZWQuaGlsbHNkYWxlLmVkdS9oaWxsc2RhbGUvY3llLTIwMjM_c2M9MDAzOTlOMDI0Mkw1WERPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWN5ZTIzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PTEyMzFfQUVfRkFMUjQ1MjYyIn0/97pnAFYoO4v--jWYlFvkTg)**

In the coming year, the anti-American Left will pull out all the stops to keep its stranglehold on government and on education alike.

It will continue in its efforts to undermine intelligent patriotism in our schools and to radically transform our free system of government.

It is not an exaggeration to say that the future of American liberty hangs in the balance.

That’s why I hope you’ll make your most generous year-end gift before MIDNIGHT TONIGHT.

Every dollar you give will get us closer to our **$6,000,000** online fundraising goal, enabling us to expand our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** in 2024.

Thank you for your generosity. We are grateful for friends like you who understand what is at stake at this critical time for our nation.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Your America
subject: Who controls whom?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

| | | This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37434%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=HmPVU7FVcL05EOQ2IqMlGg&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37445%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=GziiPTcZjNEE%2fEbGO%2fxbVA&sysid=1)**
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37446%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aQijF8lZ6VFA04m008NV0A&sysid=1) [NO](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37447%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=RWyMRSW7DGhy0tPoOB3ewg&sysid=1) For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale’s American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37445%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=GziiPTcZjNEE%2fEbGO%2fxbVA&sysid=1)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions

| This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ze8m6su2i6aco8nuc8i5522l98ncfrg7uoofotqg_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h60ob5c9h2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbohta657mamudl3qte2mdkloc38pd6v8qebvphg_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h60ob5c9h2bs)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2fsgq2pg1c6t3tlpnlh0m4entk68vmdif6eeeh0_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h60ob5c9h2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8l681edn8mj287892ak3rhbrr4nbgaotdq1e2vg_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h60ob5c9h2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

name: Trump News HQ
subject: Big Pharma and the federal government
body:
In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkfr9de9m3k8r2v70r3bk1u9sne4bsqc3e2u9kgo_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h60pb2clh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpdru5aeidkl2l1okp9er0nbeev9duumtpacccf8_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h60pb2clh2bs)**

We filmed the series at a recent Center for Constructive Alternatives conference on the Hillsdale campus. You will not have to watch for long to discover why it was one of our most popular and well-attended events.

**Please use the secure link above to receive your Big Pharma video series. When you complete the form, we will email you the series so you can watch it immediately.**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

name: Your America
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions

| This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37444%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=P2AMk3FTHb6RPQRYCtTjug&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38555%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ukVGVmosjbPP6vEK541E2Q&sysid=1)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38556%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nZKa9lekBOfNkK0j8Uqpsg&sysid=1)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38557%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fe2oTUhmoB187exeSl5y6A&sysid=1).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: I want to know your thoughts
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c689663%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=J37nwZky70IvTfav5D6YHw&sysid=1)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c689664%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=onWCQYTQ9a2Jo0VemdVoYw&sysid=1) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c689675%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uwsG1od4SMVgZJrBV9zn0Q&sysid=1)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c689676%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LqRTWcWacqRv7ZG%2bbAEFKg&sysid=1)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute
---

---
---
Your donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our country’s most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods to decrease the federal government’s role in society and to improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation’s citizens.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zapkm12r6dlt9jpivv4qagiqo4mhgfl2f3ve3pkg_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h62o36cth2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zkrbqukg9k4g79eh3du7iiq6o425ddb24tpjo65g_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h62o36cth2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

body:

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zek43le66v5dtl6lt22i7termtr79ugerhcubkig_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h62o35clh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

name: Trump News HQ
subject: Who controls whom?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

| | | This sponsored message from Trump Trian News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvjuaj8l9138udanujsv83pikriv3s6av0ufk16o_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h62p35c3h2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5mnsftjdf7l0u1togrs9k80626qahqe75nejla0_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h62p35c3h2bs)**
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zatm58lcagvp9t2fcr1d84rn4hvmuba468pjqrbo_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h62p35c3h2bs) [NO](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkodpjem1jva8lsf9321kgqooobre7643lq0fhf8_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h62p35c3h2bs) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5pihepij6g2uhhr1tjik6s8epf2fl076g96lk90_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h62p35c3h2bs)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: American Action News
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions

| This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6naisqrhg32q7afooofn3h04vt8vr2o2pn40kng_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h62o36cth2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zr851btu2h3m7a0sneqprc83ul7r6m6r7b51m9ug_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h62o36cth2bs)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zogb44oojvedoanaf8lasrcjbup9v73nq0n3q8d8_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h62o36cth2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq55ao0vpa6bgaf3hool4etsgbveaap8moh9mau8_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h62o36cth2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

name: Your America
subject: Big Pharma and the federal government
body:
In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38553%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hFpweBP9awVuIIhoi3lhpQ&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, “Big Pharma” spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today’s bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma’s reputation has come under attack in the wake of America’s opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you’ll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the “Pfizer documents,” and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You’ll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38554%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0OuUtYRm0CmSvmCQGlJoNw&sysid=1)**

We filmed the series at a recent Center for Constructive Alternatives conference on the Hillsdale campus. You will not have to watch for long to discover why it was one of our most popular and well-attended events.

**Please use the secure link above to receive your Big Pharma video series. When you complete the form, we will email you the series so you can watch it immediately.**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844**

name: American Briefing
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions

| This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z648m4bvdm61l85lv7s8v4el1r8tetofq490grcg_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h6eor6chh2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z5abeh2dq785ig10sotlb1j3q136d70korbn6p3g_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h6eor6chh2bs)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2znmjujh9poi00uravnnf7dma7lhkivfu7tchkb1g_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h6eor6chh2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvahmjs5fv96ct1ve4ne8hgv2s8m842il9cjtkm0_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h6eor6chh2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College
---

---

name: ICYMI News
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z41938atv62k3t4dbqu0rikb4k7af6a8253h4i8o_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h6eor6chh2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zl9pg90vnokfb02qa2u4kmpmmu7l7jgirgoqggs8_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h6eor6chh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z4i2lr99ihkmtfbub18hhet5nob3oc6asgr3eo48_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1h6eor6chh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zl055rcg3cg5p881d4kfvlfov8gh0uq3n6dv5u20_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1j68ob2c5h2bs)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z2qqc0vmfuhbd0si3se9185fovve7dqo1useltbo_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1j68ob2c5h2bs)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z0apepe4ns5n78k3k9veao4ijmfov32996abf32o_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1j68ob2c5h2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zcqplkjdtju1ojpu4sll2tu28o69gr143updf5t8_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1j68ob2c5h2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute
---
The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201, United States

name: David Hogg
subject: You don’t have to be obsessed with politics to know our country is in a bad place.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action PAC
body:
Hey Peter, can I get minute of your time today for something important?
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tde0bc6da-17a4-4acf-a226-dfdcc3f9df4b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
|
---
| |
---
| | | Hey, Peter, thanks for opening this email. I know a lot is going on, so I appreciate it. It’s a little long, but it’s from the heart, and it’s important. You don’t have to be obsessed with politics or watching the news 24/7 to know our country is in a bad place. Horrific violence in the Middle East. A Republican Party that has gone so far off the rails they could barely elect a Speaker. The leading Republican candidate for president is Donald Trump! And then we have unspeakable atrocities like the mass shooting in Maine because our “leaders” refuse to act. And many people talk about how Trump is a major threat to democracy and he is — but I believe there is an even greater and more long-term threat \- hopelessness. When I was knocking doors for Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate Nadarius Clark for the Virginia elections, the most concerning answer I got when I asked if people were voting was, “No, I don’t believe in voting” or “No all politics is corrupt and my vote doesn’t matter.” This scares me because things can never get better if we continue electing people who say “government doesn't work” who then get elected and make it not work. I’m deeply worried about us. And it’s not because I’m anti-America. It’s because I love this country and I desperately want to see us do better. We’re not going to fix this mess overnight. But we do have a plan. A group of us just launched Leaders We Deserve. We started it because we know that young progressive leaders can change the future of this country for the better by giving us what we need most to get through this moment of democratic backsliding, HOPE. We can elect more young leaders like Nadarius Clark, but we can ONLY do it if enough of us get behind them. For us to give the school shooting generation the hope it needs to secure the future of our democracy and build a more perfect union, we must get to work electing the next generation of morally just leaders who put kids first and the NRA out of business. The truth is that young progressive candidates who are running for office face huge barriers. The average age of our elected officials is astronomical. That’s because our election system favors those who are older, wealthy, and white. In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate. We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation. Here’s our plan:
* Find young progressives who are willing to run for Congress and state legislatures.
* Equip their campaigns with messaging, scheduling, and budget tools they need to win.
* And most importantly, raise funds from our massive national network (hey, that’s you!) to allow them to go toe-to-toe with their opponents and WIN.

Peter, if we succeed, ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically. Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve. But what we do right now will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass. We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country. Here’s what I need from you for our plan to work. – If you are blessed with the financial ability to make a really big donation (like $500 or more), please do so right now to help us make this vision a reality. [Click here if you are fortunate enough to give $500 or more.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T86c6a41c-1dac-47b8-bdab-ce817e5650d5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – If you can give a small donation each month, that makes a big impact too. [Click here if you think you can commit to a $25 monthly donation (or something like that).](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta5b44088-f78b-4dd0-bcbd-f2fc85dcb89e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – If you can’t give big and you can’t give monthly, that’s totally OK (most people can’t). [Click here to just give a one time donation of whatever you can afford.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7a468da6-f8a5-4a1e-9054-02c0d9db1f96/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – Last but not least, if you can’t chip in at all, I completely understand. All I ask is that you forward this email to three friends who might be aligned with our cause. I hope this fundraiser is as successful as I know it can be. I hope that we look back at this moment in ten years and say THIS is when everything started to change. If you have any questions at all about Leaders We Deserve, please check out our website or get in touch with us on social media. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for reading today. \- David Hogg

Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country.

body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

| | | This sponsored message from American Action News News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3ro3993f2ep62gbceheqfk0pu6m3ab1434uvlu8_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1j62o72cdh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd9eual4e6oaglbsscied14967i94c2v7rsh5bs8_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1j62o72cdh2bs)**
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6tuuj71k94rv67d983e7ajtqlgb5hc2c8iveofo_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1j62o72cdh2bs) [NO](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztb83ua901mu9fdj3evq9skkcsohhadi2ijji670_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1j62o72cdh2bs) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z84ru8uf44a5b7mm98ldja33jcfdjm8fulisqnfo_rp22sh2s8i6eo31c1j62o72cdh2bs)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c1ea1b56281a4f77aac1ee71a0d4c339&_e=ZNVx62rQYIjxJWqeYuYHzLSsCYE_6VqglvQX_sWjOlGbReRZo-Kze7Uuhg-7jx6mU3i0FYC69ON-3BIBORbpd-ACUVzbCmhhCMqE0wTYCtZs02kd7nWW6Vv_SrBcMgcoPQ4TNtFbTFF-sF1b-u_dJBtesil3pa32j-h2rX2eYMzy2vp5TRD-55Mz3M6H6__PZsLznYP3H_4wMmJqkCvdrwHIxFALU5eYpwwSFQjCzMmXcATgAzbKFgnyccIFU2-_n20MArkVGzKsviaaO9HrK2qky-iW_iHVFsjUmbw8f0hEf3_tY1h48KjP5QR1KeLEOHpuivwB2Fk4sEA2A8i_30VObZ7JsnEX7V8pZVGuYE1uGIRCLCCNvaNVWd5S6Hy8P33DzvvpvtByXHr0TVoCbm2LTJjMpmeEmX33O67aMBw%3D) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c1ea1b56281a4f77aac1ee71a0d4c339&_e=ZNVx62rQYIjxJWqeYuYHzLSsCYE_6VqglvQX_sWjOlGbReRZo-Kze7Uuhg-7jx6mU3i0FYC69ON-3BIBORbpd-ACUVzbCmhhCMqE0wTYCtZs02kd7nWW6Vv_SrBcMgcoPQ4TNtFbTFF-sF1b-u_dJBtesil3pa32j-h2rX2eYMzy2vp5TRD-55Mz3M6H6__PZsLznYP3H_4wMmJqkCvdrwHIxFALU5eYpwwSFQjCzMmXcATgAzbKFgnyccIFU2-_n20MArkVGzKsviaaO9HrK3K6onH5HMs3Vor4OGmdgt0fOSfOQV6gPIVL6IBTKRVW-dnmfEkIzFIdBFmr2qqXNguKlnsJd9lLre70UTTwI7HbaKgL6OeI62wPiGg71dVD8UfAxmug4k44Thtnmt4pu9NW4prp4cvCGCc4LJb_XLo%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c1ea1b56281a4f77aac1ee71a0d4c339&_e=ZNVx62rQYIjxJWqeYuYHzLSsCYE_6VqglvQX_sWjOlGbReRZo-Kze7Uuhg-7jx6mU3i0FYC69ON-3BIBORbpd-ACUVzbCmhhCMqE0wTYCtZs02kd7nWW6Vv_SrBcMgcoPQ4TNtFbTFF-sF1b-u_dJBtesil3pa32j-h2rX2eYMzy2vp5TRD-55Mz3M6H6__PZsLznYP3H_4wMmJqkCvdrwHIxFALU5eYpwwSFQjCzMmXcATgAzbKFgnyccIFU2-_n20MArkVGzKsviaaO9HrKw5c_tKiw4hrsNWZijrPCLKhcS0rH82EUm5r0jSWoC_yADf6KjMPk1gpndTM7LII-7xPUDWV8ZmXjLX7avHIOj7Lzru_bd_mApf-ITi47IRUcpKat3iN31pGyMnVEEsbkI5uB4TySHLQCFNO1X1m0BI%3D)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d7edc0831c7441f0938c70e43d5636e6&_e=nxCeRYC63DKCyQKRto9qnVwbkfpeV5hPymebGMJ4ENFtJgCuTrKqDpP5Y_M1Fv970k5kMJ58HQBE7K8mhjLqH2rjULgcSZU3wXkHTy-OOaMUHefOqiPtYaTOWeReGgX2Eq53aoxsP8k6UBbu6hg2lpbIWaU4xmqRVokBgcL73-6VHWOkBpkbKtzZ9iZ9zgZZFwwgQDjdYWlVVRb51RTfRk879gVWuj7cgnx9_nHSoGmq-zikof_ZimH7drSgGHcd3vCMq0J1fjlHyhnr2O7Xmn9WmNmNbuImBON67VnmGiDsIsUMc9Dhfxvq1HHA35LjFFkCSgvP0uvrvsd1kv7c-_V9Ni9RIhCzLyt5mgTFI_I12OusIWslPzWcX7tZmzBUgNS7PaouF0Mkf7VCIzyUT9gx4A44h8Yvb-dm2C-72sM%3D) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d7edc0831c7441f0938c70e43d5636e6&_e=nxCeRYC63DKCyQKRto9qnVwbkfpeV5hPymebGMJ4ENFtJgCuTrKqDpP5Y_M1Fv970k5kMJ58HQBE7K8mhjLqH2rjULgcSZU3wXkHTy-OOaMUHefOqiPtYaTOWeReGgX2Eq53aoxsP8k6UBbu6hg2lpbIWaU4xmqRVokBgcL73-6VHWOkBpkbKtzZ9iZ9zgZZFwwgQDjdYWlVVRb51RTfRk879gVWuj7cgnx9_nHSoGmq-zikof_ZimH7drSgGHcd3vCMq0J1fjlHyhnr2O7Xmrn4Cv3lRESQaI3SEYjDz1YOad9PvoxRyKbD1RjWDZgwcxRPTIPUwJs-RDL5150hoZLxC_JcCIjrhKc7JkQf4m6F0yj34D2nfjjBhAcubavEVXz8MfilAbfHCRbv0p-hFSarNDU3jjRI3Jb90e8VBJk%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d7edc0831c7441f0938c70e43d5636e6&_e=nxCeRYC63DKCyQKRto9qnVwbkfpeV5hPymebGMJ4ENFtJgCuTrKqDpP5Y_M1Fv970k5kMJ58HQBE7K8mhjLqH2rjULgcSZU3wXkHTy-OOaMUHefOqiPtYaTOWeReGgX2Eq53aoxsP8k6UBbu6hg2lpbIWaU4xmqRVokBgcL73-6VHWOkBpkbKtzZ9iZ9zgZZFwwgQDjdYWlVVRb51RTfRk879gVWuj7cgnx9_nHSoGmq-zikof_ZimH7drSgGHcd3vCMq0J1fjlHyhnr2O7Xmjka0vVFT0xpIzjFHUa2pcBLb7s4X8cPNyx7_cwN1qw-84n0N_K_tvrap7nMFswdUgpEO-dwajimzIMgOHJutgv28Lq3jDvm2W89IOn4uEMPCNkcFVFXaD3etLFhOMHzjm2H5OD1Xtkm3_fMzNEnAp0%3D)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
