body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don't say this to shock or scare you - I say it because it's true. _What we see today didn 't happen overnight. It's the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **... and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I'd know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ - radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my "comrades" made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan - then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I've dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn't tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That's why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** - and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I'm asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=74117d023a5f429f9ecee36ec54c4602&_e=CDinIq-aLd4dZGtElFExqsX_Vz9DYSBP_24YAtBwD6Rf2XIoqDAqjkD7x2rUweX0ZaGjO8Y9B7zDffMZemE17IJdW3S2ulYdW0oHpwMxXAS4uxOAqNeRJKL_qpU_mZBEmO29hDDoWsX-kFg8NUqg3Ow4oUsMEWg11PWSKXqnC377yCBfy7bm9HW7LcLI9Krg0jUy4p66YZyNw7YEayNLzpsclPCF6kk6zLhoqP2jZH5oO5mMQ__yOzxDCab792f796jaIGJG0I3nZeAFu-sODyXIsuNVG1M1QAVxhBm95e3E5lZ0XJhFU8QSEshruU5tyxBZBKodWjKyUyZ0AHzceNsMqoSA37iGrbZg3XCxs5k4BLlwWjtyDIqalefR2ois5Sk2AXh3kb5WkHTvI2aYyw%3D%3D)** When you think of "the enemy within" you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn't be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we've seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making - but most of the American people have no clue what we're up against. **That 's why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state - and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as "white supremacists" and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... "A Great Book" - Dinesh D'Souza "_The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life." - Mark Levin "David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation." Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within -- and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We've reached the point in our history that will decide our future - and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That's why I'll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left's evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=74117d023a5f429f9ecee36ec54c4602&_e=CDinIq-aLd4dZGtElFExqsX_Vz9DYSBP_24YAtBwD6Rf2XIoqDAqjkD7x2rUweX0ZaGjO8Y9B7zDffMZemE17IJdW3S2ulYdW0oHpwMxXAS4uxOAqNeRJKL_qpU_mZBEmO29hDDoWsX-kFg8NUqg3Ow4oUsMEWg11PWSKXqnC377yCBfy7bm9HW7LcLI9Krg0jUy4p66YZyNw7YEayNLzpsclPCF6kk6zLhoqP2jZH5oO5mMQ__yOzxDCab792f7C5um8WLEtO4ls35HzQzGGMXy7iD0fuj7pOVI1SoYFArfNvv6hy1i5KNm8qE9XD4EqTH5iKNs4ynIZXaTO__y9kLR7K3NXxGjsOzLZcbDbjDlDvmm9mSF1D41Y6QssiijtyHVhVu9j1ZL3z4p3WTX4Q%3D%3D)** The Left is at war with America. They don't simply disagree with us about how to make our country better - they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama's own words "radically transform" America. **And they don 't care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it's up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

| | This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=93ee20b5d14442b688dd1fcdab6e0894&_e=BgC6Ohe5XQSBjY6PNiX6blHU962Z7IYkRUoyASMBBStMb3Rg_NlOx-fhNC1yxfz58eYr0jpT-xjVb0gw3GkpAQUYZA1ERn9JQiRD7pDuHLjJ1rMg5sNSIlkwHWqACH_1ZKlcucGW_c82PvVJ5_gBI75YbvEpZOPZjbW6YDjXPde1Ud1ZGXBY71grVrCR88trDpB2-HttvApojlzSWLG0HBce-YpQrVkrjcx3vVlM97qLeP4vvhio3YK1JTFzhjCWOUrqTGl4xwuR0mS24xyTzEakYKea7bp4ol3Yk2TFr5zcRkcv2TMliHNQ3RzEszDgEh5-LDXrogTaj4zfPN8vlHWQcnRDA5RAMllt46UvxeTg5LI_LQUvVAAfsdrBDeokdSmfytSx0M5HkMAxU5UmkroR2vkoGsCAlX-pkpgie4M%3D)

Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=93ee20b5d14442b688dd1fcdab6e0894&_e=BgC6Ohe5XQSBjY6PNiX6blHU962Z7IYkRUoyASMBBStMb3Rg_NlOx-fhNC1yxfz58eYr0jpT-xjVb0gw3GkpAQUYZA1ERn9JQiRD7pDuHLjJ1rMg5sNSIlkwHWqACH_1ZKlcucGW_c82PvVJ5_gBI75YbvEpZOPZjbW6YDjXPde1Ud1ZGXBY71grVrCR88trDpB2-HttvApojlzSWLG0HBce-YpQrVkrjcx3vVlM97qLeP4vvhio3YK1JTFzhjCWrv2pW9ISYCzPjp1mGhQWsQy0GgOI1TlU0LsUiqzVqf_vGQ6f9boI4nUoBiAvEH4_Ez6__7wlt8BOVn5QwMSj4C07w6iDr90A7NajrKB8zgozuCG92WsaT0IN1UZzV3GicXD3c_wYqofXFLjgrwEF0CoHsvQt5EZv5wUXkzfL40M%3D)**
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=93ee20b5d14442b688dd1fcdab6e0894&_e=BgC6Ohe5XQSBjY6PNiX6blHU962Z7IYkRUoyASMBBStMb3Rg_NlOx-fhNC1yxfz58eYr0jpT-xjVb0gw3GkpAQUYZA1ERn9JQiRD7pDuHLjJ1rMg5sNSIlkwHWqACH_1ZKlcucGW_c82PvVJ5_gBI75YbvEpZOPZjbW6YDjXPde1Ud1ZGXBY71grVrCR88trDpB2-HttvApojlzSWLG0HBce-YpQrVkrjcx3vVlM97qLeP4vvhio3YK1JTFzhjCW1IYmUQlaHquykIJFxC7dm61wieNFsrJmxjl6i5ruWoYtxcKXBHnlqSbqclMhDXRTqGWw5rFSQI5J_mkT3uc922HvKzL9m1pjTWKpWfJhNiTsoTmLs5q-rwxZoEcwELlSnQYiQAnDCdJ2Rp8GGZQsy4hESjBbaezxiXp_71qrhLE%3D) [NO](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=93ee20b5d14442b688dd1fcdab6e0894&_e=BgC6Ohe5XQSBjY6PNiX6blHU962Z7IYkRUoyASMBBStMb3Rg_NlOx-fhNC1yxfz58eYr0jpT-xjVb0gw3GkpAQUYZA1ERn9JQiRD7pDuHLjJ1rMg5sNSIlkwHWqACH_1ZKlcucGW_c82PvVJ5_gBI75YbvEpZOPZjbW6YDjXPde1Ud1ZGXBY71grVrCR88trDpB2-HttvApojlzSWLG0HBce-YpQrVkrjcx3vVlM97qLeP4vvhio3YK1JTFzhjCWJbcVbU5TEPTcmqsxydkVQfojeVq-8J5WZCyXSQ73uXg-Cgw4JepHwfmRb3YG-YVumLifHbxY10dWM9e9AcEBxYcSoWkq6-ut4vJR5sLpl40KlHNwcoLc9hKPfI38JwdN512Vwfs1QXSCErdPJXajQFZBqhLlB4s_YPMCJnnWYcA%3D) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=93ee20b5d14442b688dd1fcdab6e0894&_e=BgC6Ohe5XQSBjY6PNiX6blHU962Z7IYkRUoyASMBBStMb3Rg_NlOx-fhNC1yxfz58eYr0jpT-xjVb0gw3GkpAQUYZA1ERn9JQiRD7pDuHLjJ1rMg5sNSIlkwHWqACH_1ZKlcucGW_c82PvVJ5_gBI75YbvEpZOPZjbW6YDjXPde1Ud1ZGXBY71grVrCR88trDpB2-HttvApojlzSWLG0HBce-YpQrVkrjcx3vVlM97qLeP4vvhio3YK1JTFzhjCWRQvus0tTuh5uzZYaM2sHJB2X2XFjN3GZD-ZVwAEw6MLtZ5mYphUkFgVrid6XPr6fmVTpWAn0cZ9lbULmA8MGU8OK6TYr092ehX2bciIJyQcDwEE2o2mtJV8XydSjYlJgdvhnxQOxGltaRB8ZZUkvYFYMVsEjmAI07L6im9Wvv2I%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=315a3b29b2fd4e04bc498f764290277e&_e=1VDZD25hjYCB1tUmdYlkTHF4KA5R_vF845f_7qpT2Tt-0UuQVYifE6aLGhNeFV4Ll6pq9WV4uyx6K_5b5S4qyM6BLCQ52eGp91Hn49hMBz5m6zaTMoMtkGN9X2Qmv095KgATXJF6C5Ji4bZPVhr1lnbzvbUW6X2wevKkbOevrClGxkgCV7Qe8J5BVsMOKIWgunZ20YfFvx7esC3w1NR3TWbYKUVr2V3SxXmdThIcVff3dIASRPrtMMmSRBVdZ1v9zEJdXYQN_ZvrqvjHjhYtBIP4O_TKA7vub8WF7-5zAOPkRB7RnFWe1xfCoMpjXcuxDUd_6RK4Uhzn9roe2Eo-HF5wv8x8S16_bbMZAsBWvRUzjAeCVBNiLpzlgSV6VZfClwtycctk_uweR66J8OahLTcl9im2G0noCvHVKcQzMBRv6nNRd7zqBUB4HyO9y1oU)

| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=315a3b29b2fd4e04bc498f764290277e&_e=1VDZD25hjYCB1tUmdYlkTHF4KA5R_vF845f_7qpT2Tt-0UuQVYifE6aLGhNeFV4Ll6pq9WV4uyx6K_5b5S4qyM6BLCQ52eGp91Hn49hMBz5m6zaTMoMtkGN9X2Qmv095KgATXJF6C5Ji4bZPVhr1lnbzvbUW6X2wevKkbOevrClGxkgCV7Qe8J5BVsMOKIWgunZ20YfFvx7esC3w1NR3TWbYKUVr2V3SxXmdThIcVff3dIASRPrtMMmSRBVdZ1v9zEJdXYQN_ZvrqvjHjhYtBAmM2ULpkU9cV3XZCC6HGtZ7ZVaqX9RNQUtDnn4dzhEDWkUv7clwo_nhj6pUVN7QAD-0Db7SorYJJ2-cQYdzIDITQOE4EiZ5aswUPNt8aIRBKH-cmk9Zf48qJ2OgH3g15un6RzHxiC-sOfrLBkGIJaRG0F4uCPR2BdqQRFMIRniN)" which you can now own on DVD.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. name: Conservative Liberty Wire
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

| | This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=032482245c54434eb51bc2066b6f9de1&_e=XSSxUdkMdjTyd3mQVJtHjlHgmMz9deL4yvOOAXD4fYJzMDrmXJu-aYXxxwgtS6TNaYheTGupPooiWmeeyMtxJUgl7N4HO9BsqPVmahY8CrvVOe4XFpZvmckt2GE0Rz5OIbyqvh424NCJHTDypjau42InVzoMq_sZ_4HrScrA7b0Jk_-JvRqZ76DGAAWvKFxF9S4-v-T99NctHfIuB8XZR-pa8KMhdZMMX9j6qG7fWHBJtIM3mEz-mIj5cuUFhbWcGHZx13yCRKRgh8wW0ppZmBE8LfB1quwjjuqd7Qktx2WuA62iuZLtjXo19Ztv5S7ImACtbhI8PMayvpzvrkxgEcXD-LCZJo0K4JJYR5kb-qmj6t0weH60rNSu-HSkstcyd3wb5FQk0s0CQrKt1KycRLlkYT3INUv6mWIwyOgdP9U%3D)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=032482245c54434eb51bc2066b6f9de1&_e=XSSxUdkMdjTyd3mQVJtHjlHgmMz9deL4yvOOAXD4fYJzMDrmXJu-aYXxxwgtS6TNaYheTGupPooiWmeeyMtxJUgl7N4HO9BsqPVmahY8CrvVOe4XFpZvmckt2GE0Rz5OIbyqvh424NCJHTDypjau42InVzoMq_sZ_4HrScrA7b0Jk_-JvRqZ76DGAAWvKFxF9S4-v-T99NctHfIuB8XZR-pa8KMhdZMMX9j6qG7fWHBJtIM3mEz-mIj5cuUFhbWc9kzgJ1SdegTfU8RQPCYzZxuiO8kTDNIesjdXXDUNbDOgBgqQHQ1AmR6kCT5qqm-duhATZ0chjfFyB6WRFxs9bAgFkCh-wKTZjBAWE_5mD0KJ-pABkK7o8cep8rwi79v42ZktpL0G0MWRnJKBVSnaYrgK05-fpqGNodZsmXG2Cng%3D)**
## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=032482245c54434eb51bc2066b6f9de1&_e=XSSxUdkMdjTyd3mQVJtHjlHgmMz9deL4yvOOAXD4fYJzMDrmXJu-aYXxxwgtS6TNaYheTGupPooiWmeeyMtxJUgl7N4HO9BsqPVmahY8CrvVOe4XFpZvmckt2GE0Rz5OIbyqvh424NCJHTDypjau42InVzoMq_sZ_4HrScrA7b0Jk_-JvRqZ76DGAAWvKFxF9S4-v-T99NctHfIuB8XZR-pa8KMhdZMMX9j6qG7fWHBJtIM3mEz-mIj5cuUFhbWcaI2fNHQI1wHlD92JaxxcVJqil_0AS8AKP_N2R7p_byp-xgv9zj9UNfHdMV9inyHXCcroZ2o_9KeSaQTJ8IWlSsbEDR7XqPHAyIvmf_9pgzzjmxticOO4-W9FEGYhVw2-7GXgqYhWW3JoKxOGs6_mW81jHiYJUuDdqYCLFRM2qCs%3D) [NO](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=032482245c54434eb51bc2066b6f9de1&_e=XSSxUdkMdjTyd3mQVJtHjlHgmMz9deL4yvOOAXD4fYJzMDrmXJu-aYXxxwgtS6TNaYheTGupPooiWmeeyMtxJUgl7N4HO9BsqPVmahY8CrvVOe4XFpZvmckt2GE0Rz5OIbyqvh424NCJHTDypjau42InVzoMq_sZ_4HrScrA7b0Jk_-JvRqZ76DGAAWvKFxF9S4-v-T99NctHfIuB8XZR-pa8KMhdZMMX9j6qG7fWHBJtIM3mEz-mIj5cuUFhbWcsCYuZa-OT37mDKbcMKdZS2WDKMQDxL1lGQs4pytsq3KkkRQuo0I56vbZhmr0ndh4CGppi0OUUnG58HaIX-wMPKHgdtPE3dHcurTzb4lkPNIdcrIIBSGFUgbC0uToK1DUa1yvlYlLKcWUMf-B2LfQZGa6HtCq4E6-mjD7NWa8QUg%3D) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

name: Restore Our Nation
subject: C.S. Lewis’s Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions
188d92cdddd40f90da47bc74ea2ba8fb
| This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/rHp6ENgLOy3fRk8IpyDXfg~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/rHp6ENgLOy3fRk8IpyDXfg~~/AARclAA~~~)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/rHp6ENgLOy3fRk8IpyDXfg~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/rHp6ENgLOy3fRk8IpyDXfg~~/AARclAA~~~).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: Big Pharma and the federal government.
body:
In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=62902f1223324231940a1a20720212ea&_e=1jYz_ZljXcpD31H6vHEinjnDE2000JphB6lAlwcXbLKyJtZ5kBN-rlv8iJPU-lnA0aXKNFqgdjAtDkAfnp9srQYgIlYHTjL37Aa69XSikUW6gL6PvnG0-VBRGe6kr8KuhLt17J6kWPnx2Z3egCT0jtoiFeMA6VdoldQWrSc4IrV1PdPoGnxLiZQbAgZXAxrKX0xBzD4_9LK8KuMguIRXlfDAguULS1YQVR62f_8J5hvFPC6UejcFFecQJJvHySj8BXjaO057OVDU99CWTPqxsBhJn0E9sjWtHgdnZhHBx1gycYUYIEYTVMyu-IJ2MxMeT81puZruRZY4e6psGkG5y7bLl57EsmrYGpCQbXIBULXlWOVdsgNshgiNGKgL61qW)

| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=62902f1223324231940a1a20720212ea&_e=1jYz_ZljXcpD31H6vHEinjnDE2000JphB6lAlwcXbLKyJtZ5kBN-rlv8iJPU-lnA0aXKNFqgdjAtDkAfnp9srQYgIlYHTjL37Aa69XSikUW6gL6PvnG0-VBRGe6kr8KuhLt17J6kWPnx2Z3egCT0jtoiFeMA6VdoldQWrSc4IrV1PdPoGnxLiZQbAgZXAxrKX0xBzD4_9LK8KuMguIRXlfDAguULS1YQVR62f_8J5hvhhCfjECkW8oC6Mv6sMciODQrc7CGyueY9YBt30BVJjv0cWGbLJkaHl0IXTNZ6sCx9I04J0L_tDzLrvjjsLte8Du_JDr2JqiJl8jquHkt7uFVL-40SwJjj8z3-HADoylQsIRYeKxt2Qv8Bt7pukKOA)**

name: Defend the Constitution
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b010d808909e4f18a98ce7484c580f18&_e=01OjB4zqGsBl_mwE2s67uT6iJLUQ4DK5nJpHV10c14dbul0sz7ugW-QsUe_3RLdxMJA2jZfaRq1Fwlnzj38sk6wUeBjVPaec7eUGTQ-Iuayj5KmBkAw8iosEJ5LnGeTNfgto35NdVOZq8aICiERppiVjyyVK19tW9I__n13-_ETnKclI--woKuKtZhRey-KTdAWz7fMl4s79tOleyVmT_AD5iFtS-QDPQd4RX3FoIKZPh4tOExZui6Fx9YAwvGeDTMjMlmA7W-82z2A8rQRRHrbU5vowGduSlY_cOsbeCy0bsJ31C6TCWHK8hK2FWUsF37DBXuGeEVu6iz5glWEdst703l08HhrpLrfRiM7QLqGGd8WhHfkzR9X-VYMFinEL8TDDh-Nj8-2Ov3ukY8EcOg%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b010d808909e4f18a98ce7484c580f18&_e=01OjB4zqGsBl_mwE2s67uT6iJLUQ4DK5nJpHV10c14dbul0sz7ugW-QsUe_3RLdxMJA2jZfaRq1Fwlnzj38sk6wUeBjVPaec7eUGTQ-Iuayj5KmBkAw8iosEJ5LnGeTNfgto35NdVOZq8aICiERppiVjyyVK19tW9I__n13-_ETnKclI--woKuKtZhRey-KTdAWz7fMl4s79tOleyVmT_AD5iFtS-QDPQd4RX3FoIKbnr29P_rhoMWzTMCEDOOalw0NYoiklw_Qp9EEO9VrfXhgUPmmLqr48uHHardyuFG42X7G0lAgQTYz_3KkPgcBNyMmbfgMV-OO0WUGd6ugpgT8-uuaU-cDJGMp-AK8PIZpPPkhWVQS05qYfziImCnD1SVqPK_qeH0rw00XM--UIhg%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Roger worked alongside President Trump to fight against high taxes, rising energy prices, and soaring healthcare costs. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. Roger serves on the Board of Trustees for the Bush School of Government and Public Service at Texas A&M University, the Texas Christian University Board of Trustees, and the National Football Foundation and College Football Hall of Fame Board of Directors.

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: My decision
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I want to talk to you about my decision to launch this campaign in the first place.
#

Peter,
Today is deadline day, and tomorrow we’ll start putting together our numbers for the report we are legally required to file with the FEC. After that, every dollar we’ve raised and every donation we’ve received will be public.
Besides the day we launched, this is the most important day of the campaign so far.
But hang on a minute. Put that aside for a second. Because right now, I want to talk to you about my decision to launch this campaign in the first place.
When I made the decision to run for Senate in Arizona, it was to take back this seat from Kyrsten Sinema. Replace her vote in the Senate with someone who actually cares about the people of our state.
That was reason enough for me.
But now, Kari Lake is running against me. The MAGA Queen. Someone who has no problem lying, spreading misinformation — even calling for her supporters to commit violence on behalf of Donald Trump.
I lived through January 6th. I heard the shouts from the mob while I was on the House floor, barricading the doors and helping my colleagues evacuate to safety. I know what Kari Lake means for our democracy.
So today, this campaign is not just about getting another vote in the Senate. It’s not just about our priorities. It still is those things, but it’s about defending our democracy now, too.
And that is a lot of pressure. Trust me... I’m feeling it. I expect you are, too. But you are not alone in this fight. I’m with you, and thousands of others are, too.
Right now, a lot of them are making donations ahead of our deadline. They’re hoping that you will join them. Because they know that is how we will win this race.
So please, I am asking you very humbly:
[**Can you contribute $3 to our campaign before this end-of-quarter FEC deadline? That’s the only way we’ll hold the Senate. That’s the only way we’ll defend it from Kari Lake.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-dec23.csjDeB&refcode=em231231-1-sm&t=1&akid=1632%2E734936%2E8e5ALy)

name: Freedom Nation Today
subject: Big Pharma and the federal government
body:
In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e3a6106a9f8644a8afb572ceb2633ac6&_e=CqpFNUwJn-nvq2ntP3LIR6aS7iw4uBh0lswlJMqDPdq9R5Id5JMN-4-GAxHrGEXU1cEW3jRaEQ_CBWwocCYVqjX6XuesogxcXlIo96VKdiU8FjGm92qFbggPkGr92jLV9TL-Oj3-4JcyA_ML20kWgove-Suw3KUrJ5F8irZG_oQW9k97bWo8hN9wywjxG_AFpJKv-_eNNtrR6XiiVLGC1ePVgwCkESFSiNA_igAV6ApTd7Qpp0D4bPAeAo3Zd2wPIp5vm8ytixCZV-wiZlGuWg3o09uhA7LitGmQvuuJKECnk98Odo92XILq9R6Fu3Bd2KGFnN-DCV6ky4Y6IGOIFm3BS4ko47vIrZRffkZ8Ptp7h85zLrPjiZ0VVYLBBkDu)

| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e3a6106a9f8644a8afb572ceb2633ac6&_e=CqpFNUwJn-nvq2ntP3LIR6aS7iw4uBh0lswlJMqDPdq9R5Id5JMN-4-GAxHrGEXU1cEW3jRaEQ_CBWwocCYVqjX6XuesogxcXlIo96VKdiU8FjGm92qFbggPkGr92jLV9TL-Oj3-4JcyA_ML20kWgove-Suw3KUrJ5F8irZG_oQW9k97bWo8hN9wywjxG_AFpJKv-_eNNtrR6XiiVLGC1ePVgwCkESFSiNA_igAV6Ar3dSg1wKYweHW56wKpKuNHwvUNTtxylIJBf60qPE_vtqLhN_veFi62Wi_p4PTFeglyPYuCGimt1s-Q2ZQotTVWHyidX67jVNbrZKnbFRdcZl8qAyfY7h-3PVAqZpu6Luemk2AQ_66M9jROdp2kzBgY)**

We filmed the series at a recent Center for Constructive Alternatives conference on the Hillsdale campus. You will not have to watch for long to discover why it was one of our most popular and well-attended events.

**Please use the secure link above to receive your Big Pharma video series. When you complete the form, we will email you the series so you can watch it immediately.**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

body:
News + editorial to start your week. | | | |
---
| | |
### __Broad + Liberty's_ Weekly Reads:_
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=be97799f07&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
| _**Having the Christmas spirit under the el.**_
---
| **Thom Nickels** wrote about Christmas 2022, when he spent some time in Philly’s ground zero in the opioid epidemic and tried to bring a little Christmas cheer to the denizens of K&A with some food, some clothes, and some good wishes. Sometimes any effort feels hopeless, but Thom recalls the words of **St. John Chrysostom** , who calls us to keep in mind that “need alone is the poor man’s worthiness” and that “we show mercy on him not because of his virtue but because of his misfortune, in order that we ourselves may receive from the Master His great mercy.” [Read more at _Broad + Liberty._](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6c93e68943&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
---
|
### _Other Top Stories..._
---
|
---
| | [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c31c2c281f&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
**Richard Koenig** wrote this week on the year that was, [looking back on the biggest stories of 2023](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=fb3c8e5ddc&e=b7b3eddce2) in the Philadelphia area and beyond. There was a lot of crazy news this year, and **2024 is only going to get weirder**.
---
|
---
| | [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d91504ebaf&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
And looking forward, **Erik Telford** of the Commonwealth Foundation wrote about some of [Governor Josh Shapiro’s catchphrases](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d9e8e90712&e=b7b3eddce2), and how he can live up to the rhetoric and the favorable press coverage he’s received in his first year in office.
---
|
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=cc074a43bc&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
From our friends at _National Review_ : Applications for the **Spring 2024 Burke to Buckley Programs** in Miami, New York, and Philadelphia are now open and the application deadline has been **EXTENDED** to _January 1st_.

NRI’s in-person **Burke to Buckley Fellowship Program** currently operates in Chicago, Dallas, Miami, New York City, and Philadelphia. The program follows a [syllabus](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=01fdf90187&e=b7b3eddce2) that fosters a rigorous examination of conservative principles and how they apply to the issues of the day. For each session of the eight seminars, participants complete a reading assignment that they then discuss over dinner with a leading conservative thinker. The classes are composed of approximately 20 mid-career professionals (between 10 and 25 years of professional work experience). This program is not intended for recent graduates or people working in the fields of public policy or politics. Participants and alumni receive invitations to exclusive networking happy hours and other annual and regional events when they occur. They also receive a complimentary ticket to the Buckley Prize Dinner in the year that they participate in the program.

_For information on the NRI Burke to Buckley Dinner-Discussion Series and to apply go[here](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=519f6ac677&e=b7b3eddce2)._

|
---
| _**What We’re Reading...**_
---
| Pennsylvania’s weirdest, tallest senator has been in the news a lot lately — even more than our other senator, who’s actually up for reelection this year. But figuring out **John** **Fetterman** is a lot more complicated than we once imagined, and definitely more complicated than figuring out **Bob Casey, Jr.** [Holly Otterbein at _POLITICO_ interviewed the freshman senator](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e42f392ab3&e=b7b3eddce2) about his first year in office, the Gaza War, and Democrats’ chances in 2024 — an interesting read about our **senatorial enigma**.

---
Dear Friend, Today, your inboxes and text messages are likely flooded with political candidate requests for end-of-year contributions. The race to raise campaign cash is insane. In the 2022 election cycle, United States House and Senate candidates collectively raised and spent almost $9 billion between January 1, 2021, and December 31, 2022. And most of this money does not go to field organizers who knock on the doors or call voters. Most of this money goes to the corporate media, nearly 45 percent. When we started to explore the viability of our campaign, we made an important decision: to run on the premise that the campaign is a service. We decided that while we can’t guarantee that we can secure a seat in the Senate (because nobody can), we can guarantee that we will provide community service while persuading voters that our campaign deserves their vote. It’s not enough to tell voters we deserve their votes; we have to show them—and so far, the response has been overwhelmingly positive. **We served food to the community in Monongalia and distributed coats and cold-weather gear in Kanawha County as part of our campaign-as-service approach. We distributed Narcan and provided training on its administration in Mercer County. We even played Santa to put smiles on children’s faces.** We will continue serving our community because actions speak louder than any campaign stump speeches can. This is not a campaign gimmick. This is who we are. Thank you for being on this campaign journey with us. Have a peaceful, safe, and healthy 2024! Zach

clean_body: | | | Dear Friend, Today, your inboxes and text messages are likely flooded with political candidate requests for end-of-year contributions. The race to raise campaign cash is insane. In the 2022 election cycle, United States House and Senate candidates collectively raised and spent almost $9 billion between January 1, 2021, and December 31, 2022. And most of this money does not go to field organizers who knock on the doors or call voters. Most of this money goes to the corporate media, nearly 45 percent. When we started to explore the viability of our campaign, we made an important decision: to run on the premise that the campaign is a service. We decided that while we can’t guarantee that we can secure a seat in the Senate (because nobody can), we can guarantee that we will provide community service while persuading voters that our campaign deserves their vote. It’s not enough to tell voters we deserve their votes; we have to show them—and so far, the response has been overwhelmingly positive. We served food to the community in Monongalia and distributed coats and cold-weather gear in Kanawha County as part of our campaign-as-service approach. We distributed Narcan and provided training on its administration in Mercer County. We even played Santa to put smiles on children’s faces. We will continue serving our community because actions speak louder than any campaign stump speeches can. This is not a campaign gimmick. This is who we are. Thank you for being on this campaign journey with us. Have a peaceful, safe, and healthy 2024! Zach | "DONATE" Zach Shrewsbury (D-WV) is running for the U.S. Senate seat as the only Democrat in the race. A native West Virginian, a Marine Corps veteran, and a grandson of a coal miner, Zach has a passion for making a difference in his community. He has seen firsthand the struggles faced by working families who are just trying to get by. Zach's military service experiences and his work as a community and climate justice organizer shaped his commitment to fighting for social and economic justice, and he's dedicated his career to making a difference in people's lives. | | | ---|---|--- Shrewsbury for Senate · PO Box 82, Fayetteville, WV 25840, United States

| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f838b486a50749ec98171bd03c975cdc&_e=dRd42NcMV-HjrwEbtFECRoY5uYjguLnzT5aY6wfxkPoNKLxMF5auoFCr9TyclOgicXPaveFgU_CDcIjJLdnpdfUivQ6GUvuL4wMARyUhdNvLnXAzsVl0P-U6PKi6TL_nKSk06dsovPsp-HPt-tZqfBaXf1Gwq2154N3ctqCkeDOwKhQneaNC5LfDhAdl2wQzfAwKa_7wuqKwN3B9LfRt3bcCo2qWvRIA9PA6KSF3548SL-gWAwqSJgvwBqJhjo6y4kwbWf1jY0s8XnWe9lsRr57bo-aemYrto3nNgpnta7pw6PJBwMPQNDmUlq-Ioqxt643mfKWe-8OAkpRvOnwGSjnbl7INr8KdkbQmH6ITV5VCDiSTC3DHIZXwr8blHgb9THg2-_1jKJTihggzPvUxWTeqFUEUSBIS9O9y9nevvAMD3U6a889HaAsVywjUaHD-)" which you can now own on DVD.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f838b486a50749ec98171bd03c975cdc&_e=dRd42NcMV-HjrwEbtFECRoY5uYjguLnzT5aY6wfxkPoNKLxMF5auoFCr9TyclOgicXPaveFgU_CDcIjJLdnpdfUivQ6GUvuL4wMARyUhdNvLnXAzsVl0P-U6PKi6TL_nKSk06dsovPsp-HPt-tZqfBaXf1Gwq2154N3ctqCkeDOwKhQneaNC5LfDhAdl2wQzfAwKa_7wuqKwN3B9LfRt3bcCo2qWvRIA9PA6KSF3548SL-gWAwqSJgvwBqJhjo6y4kwbWf1jY0s8XnWe9lsRr6RIG0DW-skyXATOAX_x-q5C_YDE2_epFnu0QCuunZcH_4EqX61zihvmxbwYOEEGsfOtCILxVwuEaqgZu4FqvLxKpUhn6zWOI69y8ra3QUPTZphQ6TOEWwGXeoh7d2_TUpJkpUy4ngsbw6feptvkzm_jCylxc1kCiWaFq4A4YdL5).

body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=dd8d02c0d51855916d19fc99b09539434388624aae9ad69501390e022d122e6c3a7b4c0e6c3e4c4bc2c2113043b7085bf29ece62f4b34fc65e287b1a0e9d75a4372c24dc77639ca34ec2d76f4c5e087f

Friend, 2024 is YOUR YEAR.

It's Ron DeSantis. I need you to know that what happens today will directly affect the course of next year, so it's important to me that we talk.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b6d1948df74b3304c600e03787d13c8e3a990b30883f7bc4b4f151caf6a434d6d9304898109c9300f50dbef27788ee607e9987694504bad19ed7f4754d4d8b40

Rush in your support before midnight

Today, every campaign competing in this race will be counting on their grassroots team to stand up,
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b6d1948df74b3304c600e03787d13c8e3a990b30883f7bc4b4f151caf6a434d6d9304898109c9300f50dbef27788ee607e9987694504bad19ed7f4754d4d8b40
fight with whatever they can give , and finish out 2023 on top. I believe we have the best grassroots team backing this campaign—and the generosity I've seen pour in at every critical point in this race has proven that to me time and time again.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b6d1948df74b3304c600e03787d13c8e3a990b30883f7bc4b4f151caf6a434d6d9304898109c9300f50dbef27788ee607e9987694504bad19ed7f4754d4d8b40

The tens of thousands of caucusgoers we've gotten to know in Iowa are FIRED UP to fight for our Great American Comeback on January 15th... but if they see that the rest of our team isn't joining in this fight during this critical stretch, we run the risk of losing their support.

This isn't a risk I'm willing to take. We have come too far to let up now.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b6d1948df74b3304555eb66f74cabf53c6aa8480c8d7e9e1a65678d1d7212b0dd6d13d097f5b7d4c5de8ba4e686b3fb4d9f9a3d18f7eebdc9f988f048a061709
Send in $10

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b6d1948df74b330467cdf05c0fa34ea60eaf9506e868814bb1bca09e1a194d24d152074123bb498e2093866898c5f92b7b862d52c68f629c479f41d81c9b1d44
Send in $25

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b6d1948df74b330432a927a24f1176e51a665247ec3e0280c421142ee6dcaa782490c873c379688bc556ce3b9976a47c8c960e3ad0dd51cc2d8fc01925ecfa77
Send in $50

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b6d1948df74b33048144a5de63ef3ec89bc3a2703e751987ce413872b8881c52bc97ab842bb0ff76a32db9929f20d7ffe786f64fca129cfa701030707b5f2492
Send in $100

One last time this year, I'm asking you to be the most important part of this campaign. Without you, we would not be on course to defeat the Left, save American kids from radical indoctrination, restore our economy, and stomp the swamp into pieces.

With you, we will get this done. I need your help now.

Yours,

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b6d1948df74b3304c600e03787d13c8e3a990b30883f7bc4b4f151caf6a434d6d9304898109c9300f50dbef27788ee607e9987694504bad19ed7f4754d4d8b40

Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b6d1948df74b3304c600e03787d13c8e3a990b30883f7bc4b4f151caf6a434d6d9304898109c9300f50dbef27788ee607e9987694504bad19ed7f4754d4d8b40

🚨 ATTENTION 🚨

Heads up! We have pre-checked the monthly donor box on our fundraising page. Monthly donors make a HUGE difference for our team and help ups plan ahead.

If one donation was all it took to defeat Joe Biden next November then we wouldn't ask for your help more than we already have, but unfortunately it's going to take more than that to win.

Please keep this box checked so we that we can count on your support.

Volunteer!

We welcome you to join Team DeSantis by volunteering to spread our message: Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for.

Help us lead our Great American Comeback by getting involved today!

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b6d1948df74b3304fdde44b7bcf8686fe2bf2ea548ebc25b977871d68d62276f68379f2e9b151b68e16b86186ced447126bf74713e7be36c571ed67ea2afd90a
Sign up here!

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b6d1948df74b3304c600e03787d13c8e3a990b30883f7bc4b4f151caf6a434d6d9304898109c9300f50dbef27788ee607e9987694504bad19ed7f4754d4d8b40

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=b6d1948df74b3304c600e03787d13c8e3a990b30883f7bc4b4f151caf6a434d6d9304898109c9300f50dbef27788ee607e9987694504bad19ed7f4754d4d8b40

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

The maximum that an individual may contribute is $6,600 ($3,300/primary & $3,300/general). The maximum that a couple using a joint account may contribute is $13,200 ($6,600/primary & $6,600/general). Contribution rules

- This contribution is made from my own funds, and funds are not being provided to me by another person or entity for the purpose of making this contribution.
- I am making this contribution with my own personal credit card and not with a corporate or business credit card or a card issued to another person.

name: Christian
subject: Signing off in 2023...
body:
Dear Peter,

2024 is not just another election year, it is a battle for the soul and safety of our country.

As a retired U.S. Army Lieutenant Colonel, I have the experience necessary to take on this battle each and every day to put an end to the political tyranny.

When I saw the way Joe Biden abandoned our troops in Afghanistan, I answered the call to serve by running to represent the people of North Carolina's 6th Congressional District. And, since then, I have not stopped.

[**Will you join me in the fight?**](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/twentytoday)

It is going to take strong conservative leadership at every level of government to turn our country back in the right direction...and we can't do it without you.

Democrats are planning a multi-million-dollar effort to break our Republican majority in the U.S. House and aim to turn North Carolina into a blue state.

I'm writing to you personally to ask for your support.

[**In order to remain on track with our year-e nd fundraising deadline, we have to raise another $1,500 by TONIGHT at 11:59 PM. **](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/twentytoday)[_**Another $10,000 will help us reach 10,000 Republican voters who frequently sit out these primaries. Maybe you can give $1,000 or more. Even $20 can help make a difference **_](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/twentytoday)

I sincerely appreciate any amount you're willing to give in order to help us reach our goal. We can't allow left-wing politicians and organizations to turn our state around. We must fight back, and we have to do it now. **I hope you 'll join me.**

**[](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/twentytoday)**

With sincere appreciation and best wishes for a Happy New Year,

Christian Castelli
Lieutenant Colonel (Retired)
U.S. Army Special Forces
Republican Candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives
(336) 810-8100

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=981%2E135344%2Ekt5K9d)

Friends--
Like many Michiganders, football is on my mind with our Wolverines going head-to-head against Alabama in the Rose Bowl tomorrow. But before we can relax and gather around the TV to cheer them on, tonight my campaign is facing our final FEC fundraising deadline of the election year.
**So today, I’m invading your inbox this morning with my own Hail Mary: Can you please make a contribution to my Senate campaign before our FEC fundraising deadline ends tonight at midnight? If you have been thinking about donating to our campaign, now would be the time.**
**[https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/Dec-EOQ](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231231-1-tt&t=2&akid=981%2E135344%2Ekt5K9d)**
I’d really love it if I could earn your support today. Because tonight at the stroke of midnight, this public reporting period is over. We need as much momentum as possible to show that we are a formidable opponent to the eventual GOP nominee. And with four serious Republican contenders getting into the race over the past few months, this public fundraising report will be looked through with a fine tooth comb to see how we stack up.
The polls are showing that this Senate race in Michigan is a dead heat with a lot of voters still undecided. That’s who we need to get to. If we fall short of our goal before our FEC deadline ends, it delays us talking to crucial voters early – especially in places outside of my current congressional district.
I need to introduce myself to the 10 million people in Michigan, and an early introduction could be the difference between winning or losing next year.
[**So please: Can you make your first online contribution to my Senate campaign before the FEC fundraising deadline ends tonight at midnight? Friend, this is the one thing that I need you to know about my race: **Florida is NOT a red state.** **_It's a gerrymandered and voter-suppressed state._**
I've raised my family here. I've built my career here. I've served this state through work with nonprofits and in Congress. I've worked hard over the years to get to know every community that calls our state home. And over these past few months, I've spent just about every spare minute meeting even more voters as I travel up and down our beautiful state.
The majority of Florida voters don't support Rick Scott's far-right agenda. They believe in protecting reproductive rights. They don't want to see their taxes go up while the top 1% gets a tax cut. They want to keep their Medicare and Social Security benefits. They don't want leaders who sow division and lie to them.
But the Florida GOP has spent years gerrymandering our state to ensure that they hold on to power in Washington and Tallahassee and totally ignore what the majority of Floridians actually believe in. That reality helps to drive down turnout and leave voters disillusioned with politics. **And then, the extremists who've gerrymandered their way into office pass more and more voter suppression bills that make it harder for voters to cast their ballots every election year.**
**Florida is NOT a red state. But I need your help to prove it.[Will you make a donation now to help me build a winning grassroots campaign? body:
We’ve accomplished so much together this year, Peter.
#
Hey Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
Before we all get busy with our New Year's celebrations today, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on everything we’ve accomplished together this year. So before I ask you to **[add a donation of any amount toward our end-of-quarter goal ahead of our deadline at midnight tonight,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40589?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585) please let me share:**
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40589?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585)**
When we launched this campaign by holding Josh Hawley accountable for his actions on January 6th, I knew we had the potential to build a powerful grassroots movement. We rallied tens of thousands of supporters together in that first week, broke fundraising records, and put a national spotlight on this U.S. Senate race.
**_National Journal_ said our campaign represents “one of the Democratic Party’s better offensive targets” in 2024** — and we’ve worked hard to prove that right.
Over the first nine months of this year, our campaign outraised Josh Hawley — breaking the record for the most ever raised at this point in the cycle by a U.S. Senate challenger in Missouri. That was huge.
We consolidated support across the state, from statewide and local unions to elected officials and community leaders. The Missouri AFL-CIO endorsed our campaign earlier than they’ve ever endorsed a challenger before. And national organizations like League of Conservation Voters announced their early endorsements because they know how high the stakes are in this race.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40589?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585)
Throughout the year, we drew out voters across the state to town halls in places like Hannibal, Cape Girardeau, and St. Joe. At our big labor rally in St. Louis County earlier this fall, hundreds of Missourians who are ready to defeat Josh Hawley in 2024 came together to support our campaign.
**And most recently, after we spent all year holding Hawley accountable to voters, multiple polls confirmed that this is already a margin-of-error race.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40589?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585)
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40589?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585)**
The unfortunate thing is that GOP insiders and corporate mega-donors have been worried about our campaign since the day we launched. **They know that Josh Hawley’s approvals are tanking among Missouri voters, and they know that our message of taking back power for working people is strong enough to flip this Senate seat next November.**
So now they’re trying everything. They attacked me for being a “nerd” and playing a card game. They transferred huge amounts to Hawley’s campaign over the course of this year to make him look strong. And over the summer, they even had a handful of mega-donors put more than a million dollars into a brand new Super PAC to fund even more attacks against me.
**[FIGHT BACK NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40589?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585)**
**After all the momentum we’ve gained over the last few months especially, there’s no telling what’s to come in the new year** — what they’ll do, say, or spend to tear down our movement and re-elect Josh Hawley.
After our deadline tonight, and once reports are submitted in a few weeks, we’ll know more about how much they’ve invested in our race. But for now, we can’t stop growing the movement we’ve built this year and we can’t afford to fall short of our end-of-quarter goal. **That’s why I’m coming directly to you, Peter:**
**[Will you add your first donation of any amount toward our goal of raising 40,000 individual donations before midnight tonight? I’m not taking a cent from corporate PACs or Big Oil + Pharma executives in this race, so you know I mean it when I say anything you can afford to give makes a big impact.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40589?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40590?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=8&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40590?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=9&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40590?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=10&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40590?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=11&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40590?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=12&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40590?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=13&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40589?refcode=em20231231-4503&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=14&akid=4503%2E614464%2Elff585)

Thank you for being on this team.
Happy New Year!
Lucas Kunce

name: Jerrad
subject: So long, 2023…what does the future hold for 2024?
body:
Tonight, I am thinking about the future. New Year’s Eve is always an exciting time, and this one is no exception.
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001brbrotfimf4QUawcGSAMFrtCvJRX6giAjsW0bTtBpWfH1ljD0fshlyoZJ1hh_GA0CPQXwh5V5Q-AHnarSBnHiGQ7sXbpRVKmDowuZxrbPBUIulp_BlChODobkea_7k1eW2BO1srYQ_118kWXYEJ6tdBshbWyyzxDN_Ig3_iNxwcYXdqkTx_46hHC6jyMXTQ0IHV8thKEg4_EbP40ZbfnMQ==&c=IeIaVxBzS_LfjhettaOvCdW8FxSNVszNDJHOKWjCw88jDwJTOUiDmg==&ch=VXjSeWzwNNMtmq6A4_U6dOfESi99f02Sy52Xukied8FfMYA6bPbefA==)

Friend,
Tonight, I am thinking about the future. New Year's Eve is always an exciting time, and this one is no exception. But I can't help but wonder about where America is headed, and what we can do to ensure we can keep making progress as a free society.
When I served in the Navy, the value of freedom and all the things I took for granted before my time in the military weighed heavily on my mind. Americans deserve peace and security, but we shouldn't lose sight of what is required--of all of us--to resolve our issues peacefully and democratically.
History provides lessons, if only we would listen. But it won't tell us everything. We need to work together, always, and find the path forward no matter how challenging the course. This great country is worth the fight.
I decided to run for Congress after long conversations with my wife, my family, and some close friends. At the end of it all, I wanted to be remembered in this moment as someone, like you, Friend, who took action when the times called for it. Someone who thought "I can make a difference" and picked up an oar and got to rowing.
So, once again, please accept my gratitude for your support. And if you can make a last-minute donation of any amount, please use the following link: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jerrad-christian](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001brbrotfimf4QUawcGSAMFrtCvJRX6giAjsW0bTtBpWfH1ljD0fshlyoZJ1hh_GA0CPQXwh5V5Q-AHnarSBnHiGQ7sXbpRVKmDowuZxrbPBUIulp_BlChODobkea_7k1eW2BO1srYQ_118kWXYEJ6tdBshbWyyzxDN_Ig3_iNxwcYXdqkTx_46hHC6jyMXTQ0IHV8thKEg4_EbP40ZbfnMQ==&c=IeIaVxBzS_LfjhettaOvCdW8FxSNVszNDJHOKWjCw88jDwJTOUiDmg==&ch=VXjSeWzwNNMtmq6A4_U6dOfESi99f02Sy52Xukied8FfMYA6bPbefA==)
So long, 2023...what does the future hold for 2024?
I hope, at least, whatever we will make of it, together.

Very Respectfully,
Jerrad Christian

body:
Let’s finish the year strong
| Peter,
---
We are just hours away from entering the election year and I need your help.
---
**As the Left’s #1 target in the top battleground district of 2024, we have been constantly under attack from the Left’s multi-million-dollar warchest.**
---
_And as we inch closer and closer to Election Day, those attacks are only going to get worse as the Left does everything it can to derail my campaign._
---
_That’s why I’ve sent an ambitious end-of-year goal to ensure we have the necessary funds and resources to not only share our winning message with voters but also combat the Left’s ongoing attacks._
---
But with the deadline just hours away we have fallen behind our goal by **$8,237**.
---

Dear Peter, As we near the close of this transformative year, we find ourselves reflecting on the remarkable journey we've embarked upon together in the Cornel West for President campaign. This campaign is part of a movement that stands on the shoulders of heroes such as Fannie Lou Hamer and Martin Luther King and will persist long after the 2024 election. Together, we are constructing something that transcends the limitations of a greedy duopoly — we are raising a flame for truth, justice and love.
---
[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=5&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_year_fundraiser&n=2)
---
We have seen the hoodwinking of many with false promises, but we stand united in our understanding that real change comes from the ground up. When we join forces to struggle, cry, dance, laugh, sing, and build together, we create a foundation for bottom-up power building for the poor and working class.
---

---
This moment we find ourselves in is not just a blip on the electoral calendar; it's a significant juncture in an ongoing movement—one that requires your continued support. The power we've generated together has the potential to resonate all the way to November and beyond. As we approach the end of the year, I am reaching out to ask for your support. We are just a few thousand dollars away from our monthly goal, and your contribution today will help us reach and exceed the expectations of the establishment! Your contribution will not only sustain our campaign but also fuel the momentum of a movement that seeks to dismantle the status quo and replace it with a society founded on justice, compassion, and equality. We stand for lasting peace and for the sanctity of life on all corners of the globe.
---

By contributing to the Cornel West for President campaign, you're investing in a future where our collective efforts will redefine the political order and create lasting change for the better. Together, we can ensure that the ideals we hold dear will endure far beyond the confines of any election cycle. **Thank you for being an integral part of this movement, Peter. Your support is the driving force behind our shared vision, and we are grateful for every step we take together toward a more just and loving society.**

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

body:
We’re counting on your support before midnight. | | | Hi Peter, Over the past month, you’ve heard from a handful of folks affected by DACA. **Martha** , **Sheridan** , and **Bruna** shared that getting DACA protections opened up their futures — allowing them to pursue education and careers in ways they couldn’t before. We heard stories from **Mari** , **Yazmin** , and **Karen** , who all had a family member left behind by DACA — opening them up to being separated from their families. **JuanJo** and **Carolina** told us how tired they are of the instability that comes along with being a DACA recipient — receiving safety in two-year increments and always having your protections hanging by a thread in the justice system. And **Katia** and **Judith** bravely shared their experience of being left out of DACA, and how they deal every day with being undocumented — living in constant fear of being detained or deported. Their stories are different, but they all share one thing in common: their **resilience.** 🧡 That’s why we at UWDA fight so hard — for _Mari, Yazmin, Bruna, Katia, JuanJo, Carolina, Martha, Sheridan, Karen, Judith,_ and the millions of immigrants around the country working to chase their dreams and better their communities. _Who just want to live free from the constant terror of being undocumented._ **So please, when making your final end-of-year contributions, include United We Dream Action on your list of organizations to support. Friend,
Serving as a member of Congress, getting to represent my community, and fighting for working people across Minnesota and the entire country is one of the joys of my life.
It's an honor and a privilege, and one that I don't take for granted.
But if you asked me what the _worst_ part of this job is, it is, without a doubt, the obscene amount of money it costs to run a successful campaign.
That's especially true when the right wing and their super PACs target a campaign as directly as they do ours, spending unlimited sums of dark money on everything from bigoted ads to propping up my opponents to try and defeat us.
Now, as you probably know, we don't fund our campaign the way a lot of my colleagues do.
I don't take money from corporate PACs, or Wall Street billionaires, or fossil fuel industry lobbyists. From the very beginning, we've funded this thing a different way — together.
I believe in grassroots, people-powered movements. I believe that so long as we're in it together, lots and lots of people chipping in what they can is more powerful than anything the super PACs can throw at us.
But running a campaign that way means that from time to time, I need to lean on people like you for support.
And with just over 12 hours to go until our FINAL official FEC fundraising deadline of the year, our job today is to raise as many grassroots contributions as we possibly can.
So please. I'm asking:

body:

Dear Peter,
2023 is officially in the books, and I wanted to take a moment to say thank you. It was a year of wins for our campaign, big and small, and none of it would have been possible without you!
Thank you for being a part of Team Roca. We’re so grateful for your continued support. Everything we have accomplished has been because of you, and I can’t even imagine how amazing 2024 is going to be!
So what did we accomplish in 2023?
* Fundraised over $150,000 dollars thanks to your generosity and support
* Received our first national endorsement from ViewPAC!
* Added over 1,000 individual donors/supporters to our house file
* Sent over 65,000 letters through our direct mail efforts
* Reached over 50,000 potential voters through social media
* Placed over 75 large signs across the district

I want you to know that we are working extremely hard to flip Maryland’s 6th district back for Republicans. With you support, we will make it through the primary in May and we will WIN in the general election next November.
Thanks again for an amazing year! Happy New Year to you and your loved ones, and we can’t wait to see what 2024 will bring for us all!
Sincerely,

body:
| | Hi, Peter, I’m Kathianne, Brian’s wife, and Abeni’s mama (and mama to our dogs, Disco and Moe, of course!). [**I'm reaching out to ask you to chip in $5 to Brian's campaign ahead of his important FEC end-of-year fundraising deadline at midnight.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76172750/446860188/1416552317?refcode=em23_231231_EOY7_fndd_gq_act___KSW_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_231231_EOY7_fndd_gq_act___KSW_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=c4a9ed7c-efa7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzRhOWVkN2MtZWZhNy1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0H0kXhnn7RiI0AiXUujv_lkesapchgpliVbIix07kD8=) But first, I want you to know why your support is so crucial.

Brian and I have been together since July 4th, 2001. Since the beginning, we’ve been two very different people.

Brian is the oldest of two children; I’m the youngest of six. Brian grew up in a military family that moved around; I lived in the same house until I left for college. I’m an open book; Brian’s an intensely _private_ person.

The course of our entire lives changed on Thursday, July 7th, 2016, when Brian picked up a trauma surgeon shift at Parkland Hospital. That night, he was tasked with caring for seven police officers who were gunned down at a Black Lives Matter march and sadly had to tell many of their families that he was unable to save them.

While he’s declined media interviews in the past, the hospital had scheduled a press conference the next day. He had an opportunity to use his voice as a Black doctor to speak about race, gun violence, and the pain the Dallas community was feeling.

Something changed in him that night. My private, introverted husband took a chance at vulnerability. Without seeking it, he **was given an incredible platform and a chance to give a voice to the voiceless.**

We both knew he couldn’t stop there.

Throughout his entire life, Brian has dedicated himself to service. First in service to our nation in the Air Force, then in the trauma bay (When we met as he was starting his career, he was pulling 120+ hours a week!). Now, he’s running to serve TX-32 in Congress.

I’m so proud of my husband for choosing to **Be the Change** , and I’m so grateful that he has you by his side on this campaign. As we wrap up 2023 and all the amazing things this year has brought us, [**I hope you’ll help us continue building momentum with a donation toward Brian’s $100,000 end-of-year FEC fundraising goal. Any amount will make a big difference for Brian’s
