body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
Friend —
A groundbreaking report by ProPublica revealed:
Far-right Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas suggested to a Republican member of Congress that he might resign if Congress didn’t increase Supreme Court justices’ salaries.
After that conversation in 2000, Republican megadonors lavished Clarence Thomas with “a stream of gifts from friends and acquaintances that appears to be unparalleled in the modern history of the Supreme Court,” from luxury vacations to tuition payments.
After Mitch McConnell and Donald Trump conspired to stack the Court with three far-right justices, the result for our country has been disastrous.
From abortion bans and the end of affirmative action, to environmental degradation, repealing gun safety measures, blocking student loan relief, and more, the Supreme Court is the most extreme it has been in generations, and far from the fair, just, impartial judicial body the framers intended it to be.
That’s why I’ve led the efforts to pass legislation to expand the Supreme Court and institute term limits and a code of ethics, so that the open corruption we’ve suffered from does not continue.
That’s what I’ll fight for in the U.S. Senate, where California’s next Senator will be responsible for casting votes to confirm or deny Supreme Court justices. If you can split a donation between Seth Moulton and my campaign of $25 or more ahead of my end of quarter FEC deadline to help in this fight, I’m personally asking you to chip in right now. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
The work to strengthen our democracy and ensure that our children and grandchildren grow up in a world that has more rights and freedoms than today is a moral imperative — and I won’t rest until that’s what we’ve achieved.
— Adam

When I know I'm going to get good news and bad news together, I always want to hear the bad news first. So I'll start with this: **2023 was another hard year for reproductive rights in America.** Republicans, empowered by a rigged Supreme Court, have banned or severely restricted abortion in 21 states. Four other states have bans tied up in court. The urgency to elect women who will win us back our rights has never been higher.

But here's the good news: **This is what EMILYs List was built for.** This team has what it takes to fight back against anti-choice extremism _everywhere_. I know the struggle for fundamental rights is demoralizing and exhausting. Republicans are _hoping_ the pro-choice majority is too demoralized and too exhausted to fight back. | More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

Hi Friend,
Hope you’re doing great this New Year's Eve! I’m Ali from Cincinnati. I’m Keen on Dean, and here’s why:
Medicare for All Advocate: Dean is all in for universal healthcare, and I'm on board with his push for Medicare for All. It's time we ensure every American has access to healthcare without drowning in debt.
Affordable Housing Champion: With 7 million homes needed and half a million folks living on the streets, Dean's call for a massive housing initiative is something I believe is long overdue. It's time to get serious about housing for every American.
Education Reform Enthusiast: Dean's stance on education resonates with me. The burden of student debt is real, and he's committed to addressing this absurdity. College education should empower, not shackle, our young people.
Practical Approach to the Southern Border: Dean recognizes the Southern border situation is a complex issue. It's both a national security problem and a humanitarian crisis. His commitment to finding a real, lasting solution is something I find refreshing.
Peace We Deserve: I appreciate Dean's forward-thinking approach to foreign policy. It's not just about reacting—it's about anticipating problems, making investments to prevent crises, and ensuring a more peaceful world for generations to come.
Bridge Builder Between Parties: In an age of intense partisanship, Dean stands out as a unifier. His ability to connect with both Democrats and Republicans is something we desperately need in a leader.
Join me in supporting Dean — chip in $25 now! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dean24-email?refcode=12.31.2023.ali&amount=25]
But here's the real deal-breaker for me: I am convinced that Dean is our best shot at taking down the Republican nominee, whoever that may be. I've been digging into the polls from the last year, and they consistently show Dean Phillips in a stronger position compared to the other contenders. He understands the pulse of the people, and it's high time we have a leader who resonates across the board.
Their fundraising deadline is tonight at midnight. The countdown to New Years Eve, is also a countdown to their ability to make waves in 2024. If you can help, consider a gift of $25. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dean24-email?refcode=12.31.2023.ali&amount=25]

Throughout this year, Congresswoman Cori refused to accept the status quo, because the status quo of a system of oppression is oppression. She refused to accept a status quo where our so-called justice system sees Black, brown and Indigenous people as somehow more criminal and dangerous, that allows police to brutalize and kill our people with impunity, then turns around and perpetually increases no-strings-attached money for policing and wars while stripping our communities of critical funding. She refused to accept a status quo that bans abortion care. She refused to accept a status quo where people are paid $7.25 an hour while corporate profits soar as executives capitalize off of a crisis of greedflation. She refused to accept a status quo that allows our trans siblings to be repeatedly targeted by legislation. She refused to accept a status quo that funds the oppression of our Palestinian siblings and of communities striving for liberation and self-determination worldwide. She refused to accept a status quo where we destroy our environment because Big Oil CEOs want another yacht. She refused to accept a status quo that burdens regular, everyday folks with medical debt and education debt in the wealthiest nation in the world. Congresswoman Cori refuses to accept the status quo of the very system that is hurting our communities. ## **ABOUT US**
[ _Citizens for Free Enterprise_](https://ssjjz.mjt.lu/lnk/AVYAADFs_yQAAcg6NVYAAPXnhIAAAYCtSSIAnYvcACac8ABlkY6aDu7Bb5yNRB2X6u_6dVaU9wAjuaE/9/BLVDtUE7caiOBN95v2lmBA/aHR0cHM6Ly9jaXRpemVuc2ZvcmZyZWVlbnRlcnByaXNlLmNvbT91dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249QnVpbGRpbmclMjBhJTIwU3Ryb25nZXIlMjBGdXR1cmUlM0ElMjBPdXIlMjBDb21taXRtZW50JTIwdG8lMjBGcmVlJTIwRW50ZXJwcmlzZSUyMChQcm9zcGVjdGluZ19DNmMpJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1tYWlsamV0) stands at the center of the fight for continued American prosperity. We promote free enterprise, so all Americans understand the role it has in creating a dynamic economy and people’s ability to climb the income ladder.

**Here's What We Do...**

**PROMOTE OPPORTUNITY**
Opportunity is at the heart of our free enterprise system. An economy that creates greater opportunity empowers people to pursue their aspirations and reach their goals, allowing them to provide for their families in the process. We work to advance policies that foster more opportunity.

**FIGHT BUREAUCRATIC OVERREACH**
Regulation must remain limited and effective for businesses to grow and consumers to reap the benefits. The free-market economy has demonstrated its ability to succeed, often after the government has failed. We fight to prevent the government from stifling entrepreneurialism and hurting the American worker.

**DEFEAT BIG GOVERNMENT SOCIALISM**
Progressive lawmakers have shown no hesitation to pursue a socialist agenda, normalizing the idea that economic solutions come from more government control. History tells us socialism has failed every place it’s been adopted. Now, we stand ready to protect and promote the economic policies that have made our country the most prosperous in the world. With the help of principled lawmakers and people like you, we can safeguard for everyone an economic system that provides equality of opportunity for all who seek a happier, more financially secure life. Stay tuned in the coming months to find out more about our initiatives, and opportunities to get involved.

clean_body: | | | | | Since the launch of Citizens for Free Enterprise earlier this year, I’ve been fortunate to spend time traveling the country to promote the value of our free enterprise system. The need to organize like-minded individuals around this common goal has never been greater. I’m proud of what we’re building at Citizens for Free Enterprise and believe in our mission ahead. The economic principles that made America the greatest country in the world must be protected. That is what motivates us every single day. Some of the exciting events of 2023... | | | | As we turn to the new year, I appreciate your continued interest in Citizens for Free Enterprise and look forward to sharing more of our work. | Doug Ducey Former Governor, Arizona ABOUT US stands at the center of the fight for continued American prosperity. We promote free enterprise, so all Americans understand the role it has in creating a dynamic economy and people’s ability to climb the income ladder. Here's What We Do... PROMOTE OPPORTUNITY Opportunity is at the heart of our free enterprise system. An economy that creates greater opportunity empowers people to pursue their aspirations and reach their goals, allowing them to provide for their families in the process. We work to advance policies that foster more opportunity. FIGHT BUREAUCRATIC OVERREACH Regulation must remain limited and effective for businesses to grow and consumers to reap the benefits. The free-market economy has demonstrated its ability to succeed, often after the government has failed. We fight to prevent the government from stifling entrepreneurialism and hurting the American worker. DEFEAT BIG GOVERNMENT SOCIALISM Progressive lawmakers have shown no hesitation to pursue a socialist agenda, normalizing the idea that economic solutions come from more government control. History tells us socialism has failed every place it’s been adopted. Now, we stand ready to protect and promote the economic policies that have made our country the most prosperous in the world. With the help of principled lawmakers and people like you, we can safeguard for everyone an economic system that provides equality of opportunity for all who seek a happier, more financially secure life. body:

Hi Friend,
I hope you are enjoying this Holiday Weekend and have had time to relax and connect over the past weeks! I am so grateful for the time I've had with my family and seeing so many of you across this wonderful City and Commonwealth.
I can hardly believe that on Tuesday, I will be inaugurated as a member of Philadelphia's City Council. I am so excited for this new beginning and ready to get to work on all of the plans that I shared with you throughout my campaign. As always, I truly could not have gotten here without you and I know that you will be in my corner as we govern and lead moving forward.
I have one final fundraising deadline of 11:59pm on 12/31/23 and I need your help . It's important for me to show as much and as many supporters as possible on my final finance reports for the year. People are watching closely! It's also important that I have the resources necessary to keep a political operation running. Next year, Philadelphia and Pennsylvania will be in the national spotlight and I intend to play a pivotal role in ensuring that our democracy is defended and that we elect quality candidates up and down the ballot.
I am so grateful for everything you have done to get me to this position and I cannot wait to see what 2024 has in store!
Wishing you a New Year filled with blessings, peace, and joy.
Sincerely,
Councilmember-Elect Nina Ahmad

| Peter,

The clock is ticking, and there are only 16 hours left until our end-of-quarter deadline. We are so close to reaching our fundraising goal and making a real impact in supporting our military personnel and securing our borders. [Will you join us in this critical mission?](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=076d48c55b&e=273c9a71fb)

As a candidate for Congress and a veteran, I know firsthand the importance of standing by our brave men and women in uniform. They protect our freedoms and safeguard our American way of life. [Your generous contribution will ensure they have the unwavering support, resources, and respect they deserve.](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=071a098ea8&e=273c9a71fb)

Additionally, we are facing a border crisis that threatens our national security and the stability of our communities. By supporting our campaign, you will help us advocate for legislation that prioritizes border security and enforces our immigration laws, protecting our citizens and upholding the rule of law.

Time is running out, but together, we can make a difference. [Every dollar counts, and your donation will directly impact our efforts to support our military and secure our borders.](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=7616a73a89&e=273c9a71fb)

Thank you for your unwavering support. Together, we can build a stronger and more prosperous America.

Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. This one, in fact: ↘↘ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76178723/446878511/-1359812268?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20231231_EMDF_E1_T1_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWMyZjhhNS1mNWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x50R78stX1Q55RVp0WpjaV5GVRfPTJd6W8GUpbHLFEg=) Yes, really. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain.

I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips.

**I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76178724/446878512/-1359812268?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20231231_EMDF_E1_T1_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWMyZjhhNS1mNWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x50R78stX1Q55RVp0WpjaV5GVRfPTJd6W8GUpbHLFEg=) My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family.

Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families.

You see, the New York City government shoveled over _$100 million in government aid_ to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. _They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street._

But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: **Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families.**

When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it.

I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress.

Right now, the shadow of Trump and his MAGA cult looms large. They're determined to strip our right to vote, give tax breaks to people like Trump, and put special interests ahead of working families _– and they’re raising millions to pull it off._

But we have something they don’t, Peter: A powerful grassroots movement made up of working people, not faceless corporations. As we get ready to close out the year, I would like to say thank you for supporting me and my campaign during this year. | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/dd461185d0b4/john-lee-mayor-who-rescued-north-las-vegas-announces-for-congress-12672743?e=91a702298f)

Friend,
As we get ready to close out the year, I would like to say thank you for supporting me and my campaign during this year. All of your support has been very helpful in my mission to win the hearts and minds of those across NV-04 and let them know that Republican leadership works for them.
[](https://johnleeforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18876e295d2df144af23d05e5&id=e8409bf1bf&e=91a702298f)
As 2024 rolls around, this will be a pivotal year for our party and our country.
We have two roads ahead of us: A road filled with lawlessness, economic ruin, and corruption. Or one of prosperity, liberty, and the rule of law.
It’s our choice to make, but I am honored to be doing my part to advance freedom and keep our House majority.
Thank you once again for everything that you’ve done to support this campaign. I will not let you down, and I look forward to taking that oath of office in 2025 as the next Representative of NV-04.
**See you in 2024! Let’s get to work!**
**Warm Regards,**_Fmr. Mayor John J. Lee_
Candidate for Congress NV-04

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdcba7634-89e6-4739-883a-ba2739707d3c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

However – I refuse to sit back quietly and let Republicans get their way. _I made a promise that I won’t stop fighting in Congress until my communities are kept safe and protected._ I won’t let the GOP decide when my time in Congress is over. Let’s recall that this is the _**second time**_ Georgia Republicans have drawn a district I represent over 20 points to Donald Trump. **I’m fully prepared to return to Congress in 2024.** [**But Peter, I’d be lying if I told you it’s an easy path ahead of me. I only have a few months before this next election, and we need to put my campaign into overdrive. Can you rush a donation ASAP to Blue Amp Action and myself before the end-of-year deadline on Sunday to help make sure I can continue leading the gun safety movement in Congress?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T258db845-e198-49f4-9647-f242b9867e06/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Ruben and I are in the middle of making some difficult decisions right now. We need you to hear about them.
#

Peter, it’s Nichole Johnson. I’m running Ruben’s campaign for Senate in Arizona.
Not sure if you saw my text yesterday, but Ruben and I are in the middle of making some difficult decisions right now. We need you to hear about them.
It’s no secret that we’re right up against our final FEC fundraising deadline of the year right now. When it hits in just a few hours we’re legally required to roll out our numbers for everyone to see.
But what that also means is that we’re about to make some of the most important — and difficult — decisions of the campaign.
Millions of dollars in attack ads are coming our way. Kari Lake is lining up support across the GOP. Kyrsten Sinema could jump in this race at any time.
What all that means is that we’re going to need a ton of money to fight back. Unfortunately, we don’t have what we need in our campaign warchest right now. Tough but true.
So Ruben and I talked, and we decided we needed to give the green light anyway. But that means we have to raise our goals for this FEC deadline.
This is a risk. Make no mistake. But we’re betting on you, Peter. We’re betting that you’ll come through for us and help fill that budget gap.
And we hope you will — because our majority in the Senate is going to come down to this race.

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=eef22e8100305cfcdec89bc65f0eaf3363dc8443fe96d4a0246a9f6b251339ebce6ac6db8fc7ae782b42d88a0e970e732e425e2378f1fac5418250f8bf771fb8

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

[Youth vote shenanigans enclosed]

| | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76182283/446889887/240436357?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWZlZThkNS1mOWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OoKgInD0Atc4DdGs5GnHgRyXF29zeHbE1wqnn7Bzphw=&emci=a3d6fe2f-a49e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=8afee8d5-f9a7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=6787172) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76182290/446889894/1808364420?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWZlZThkNS1mOWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OoKgInD0Atc4DdGs5GnHgRyXF29zeHbE1wqnn7Bzphw=&emci=a3d6fe2f-a49e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=8afee8d5-f9a7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=6787172) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76182293/446889901/1808364420?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWZlZThkNS1mOWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OoKgInD0Atc4DdGs5GnHgRyXF29zeHbE1wqnn7Bzphw=&emci=a3d6fe2f-a49e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=8afee8d5-f9a7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=6787172) We’ve had a big year, team. From fighting for abortion access to pointing and laughing (sometimes cringing) at the shenanigans in Congress, 2023 has proven to be a year we won’t be forgetting any time soon. Most significantly we proved **yet again** that the youth vote is powerful and that young Americans are ready to make a difference. NextGen is dedicated to empowering the youth vote. That wouldn’t be possible without your support every step of the way. So before the ball drops, we wanted to give our thanks to you and let you know the difference the youth vote has made.
* * *

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76182296/446889904/-1041085244?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWZlZThkNS1mOWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OoKgInD0Atc4DdGs5GnHgRyXF29zeHbE1wqnn7Bzphw=&emci=a3d6fe2f-a49e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=8afee8d5-f9a7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=6787172) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76182298/446889908/-1041085244?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWZlZThkNS1mOWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OoKgInD0Atc4DdGs5GnHgRyXF29zeHbE1wqnn7Bzphw=&emci=a3d6fe2f-a49e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=8afee8d5-f9a7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=6787172) With key issues like abortion access on the line in several states, the youth vote showed up and showed out at the polls this year. Young voters refused to be taken in by false promises and confusing rhetoric. Thanks to volunteers spending countless hours spreading the word about these critical elections, millions of young people headed to the polls to make their voices heard. **And that’s something to celebrate.**
* * *

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76182299/446889910/-1041085244?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWZlZThkNS1mOWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OoKgInD0Atc4DdGs5GnHgRyXF29zeHbE1wqnn7Bzphw=&emci=a3d6fe2f-a49e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=8afee8d5-f9a7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=6787172) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76182301/446889911/-1041085244?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWZlZThkNS1mOWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OoKgInD0Atc4DdGs5GnHgRyXF29zeHbE1wqnn7Bzphw=&emci=a3d6fe2f-a49e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=8afee8d5-f9a7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=6787172) Issues like abortion access and voting rights were top of mind for young Americans heading to the polls. With threats to our rights coming from seemingly all directions, it was more important than ever to encourage new voters to get registered and make sure established voters knew that their vote still mattered. Young people fought for our rights all year long and won major battles in key states like Virginia and Pennsylvania. We’re not done fighting, and we know we can count on you to keep showing up for our rights in 2024 and beyond.
* * *

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76182303/446889913/121714170?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWZlZThkNS1mOWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OoKgInD0Atc4DdGs5GnHgRyXF29zeHbE1wqnn7Bzphw=&emci=a3d6fe2f-a49e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=8afee8d5-f9a7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=6787172) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76182306/446889916/121714170?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWZlZThkNS1mOWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OoKgInD0Atc4DdGs5GnHgRyXF29zeHbE1wqnn7Bzphw=&emci=a3d6fe2f-a49e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=8afee8d5-f9a7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=6787172) Young people, and especially young people of color, have been hit the hardest by the impacts of our current climate crisis. In 2023, we saw some of the fiercest fighting from young Americans to take a stand against climate change, with amazing results! Since the Inflation Reduction Act was passed, young Americans have and will continue to see huge results on climate. And since there’s no Planet B, we’re going to keep fighting climate change for all of 2024 and beyond.
* * *

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76182309/446889919/-1800600131?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWZlZThkNS1mOWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OoKgInD0Atc4DdGs5GnHgRyXF29zeHbE1wqnn7Bzphw=&emci=a3d6fe2f-a49e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=8afee8d5-f9a7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=6787172) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76182312/446889922/-1800600131?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWZlZThkNS1mOWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OoKgInD0Atc4DdGs5GnHgRyXF29zeHbE1wqnn7Bzphw=&emci=a3d6fe2f-a49e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=8afee8d5-f9a7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=6787172) Vulnerable communities across the country have faced ignorant attacks throughout 2023. Thankfully, young Americans have refused to let that slide. We’ve protested bans on drag, fought against attacks on trans kids, stood strong with victims of racist extremism, and much more. **We’re not going to stop fighting for human dignity.** And we’re so glad that you’re in this fight with us. 2023 might be over, but 2024 is already shaping up to be a year like none other. We need all hands on deck to empower the youth vote to show up and show out at the polls in November. [So if you haven’t already, will you pledge to vote in 2024 and use your voice to make a difference?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76182315/446889925/928283224?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWZlZThkNS1mOWE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OoKgInD0Atc4DdGs5GnHgRyXF29zeHbE1wqnn7Bzphw=&emci=a3d6fe2f-a49e-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=8afee8d5-f9a7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=6787172)

clean_body: [Youth vote shenanigans enclosed] | | We’ve had a big year, team. From fighting for abortion access to pointing and laughing (sometimes cringing) at the shenanigans in Congress, 2023 has proven to be a year we won’t be forgetting any time soon. Most significantly we proved yet again that the youth vote is powerful and that young Americans are ready to make a difference. NextGen is dedicated to empowering the youth vote. That wouldn’t be possible without your support every step of the way. So before the ball drops, we wanted to give our thanks to you and let you know the difference the youth vote has made. With key issues like abortion access on the line in several states, the youth vote showed up and showed out at the polls this year. Young voters refused to be taken in by false promises and confusing rhetoric. Thanks to volunteers spending countless hours spreading the word about these critical elections, millions of young people headed to the polls to make their voices heard. And that’s something to celebrate. Issues like abortion access and voting rights were top of mind for young Americans heading to the polls. With threats to our rights coming from seemingly all directions, it was more important than ever to encourage new voters to get registered and make sure established voters knew that their vote still mattered. Young people fought for our rights all year long and won major battles in key states like Virginia and Pennsylvania. We’re not done fighting, and we know we can count on you to keep showing up for our rights in 2024 and beyond. Young people, and especially young people of color, have been hit the hardest by the impacts of our current climate crisis. In 2023, we saw some of the fiercest fighting from young Americans to take a stand against climate change, with amazing results! Since the Inflation Reduction Act was passed, young Americans have and will continue to see huge results on climate. And since there’s no Planet B, we’re going to keep fighting climate change for all of 2024 and beyond. Vulnerable communities across the country have faced ignorant attacks throughout 2023. Thankfully, young Americans have refused to let that slide. We’ve protested bans on drag, fought against attacks on trans kids, stood strong with victims of racist extremism, and much more. We’re not going to stop fighting for human dignity. And we’re so glad that you’re in this fight with us. 2023 might be over, but 2024 is already shaping up to be a year like none other. We need all hands on deck to empower the youth vote to show up and show out at the polls in November. | "CTA Button" See you in the new year, NextGen America | NextGen America 548 Market Street #98097 San Francisco, CA 94104 This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com | =

name: Team AOC
subject: 2023 in photos
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Thank you for making this year so special.
#
**A look back at 2023 in photos...**
**January 2023**
We joined a picket line with the New York State Nurses Association in The Bronx to support their fight for better pay and safer staffing protocols at their hospitals — and after a 3-day strike, the nurses won a 19.2% pay raise and an unprecedented increase in nurse-to-patient staffing ratios.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231231-1.0YiqFi&refcode=em20231231-5566-P_FND_EOQ_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5566%2E2526796%2Ebzq1k5)
**April 2023**
Alexandria rallied with progressive city and state officials in Queens to push for inclusion of progressive priorities in the New York State Budget — including increased environmental protections, prison reform, public housing, and Good Cause Eviction protections.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231231-1.0YiqFi&refcode=em20231231-5566-P_FND_EOQ_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5566%2E2526796%2Ebzq1k5)
**July 2023**
After a town hall in The Bronx, Alexandria meets with organizers working to alleviate transit congestion and pollution by reimagining an expressway that runs through parts of her district.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231231-1.0YiqFi&refcode=em20231231-5566-P_FND_EOQ_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5566%2E2526796%2Ebzq1k5)
Alexandria also stood in solidarity with SAG-AFTRA workers in New York during their 118 day strike.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231231-1.0YiqFi&refcode=em20231231-5566-P_FND_EOQ_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5566%2E2526796%2Ebzq1k5)
**August 2023**
As street vendors in Queens fight for small business protections, Alexandria rallied with local elected officials to show support for street vendors contributions to New York’s culture and economy.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231231-1.0YiqFi&refcode=em20231231-5566-P_FND_EOQ_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=5566%2E2526796%2Ebzq1k5)
**September 2023**
Alexandria and Team AOC participated in 26 different back-to-school events across NYC, and distributed over 1,000 backpacks to children who didn’t have one as the school year began.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231231-1.0YiqFi&refcode=em20231231-5566-P_FND_EOQ_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=5566%2E2526796%2Ebzq1k5)
Alexandria spoke at the March to End Fossil Fuels — where over 70k people came together to peacefully protest our reliance on fossil fuels, in the largest climate march in the US since the pandemic — and urged the crowd to make sure that our movement for a Green New Deal became ‘too big and too radical to ignore.’
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231231-1.0YiqFi&refcode=em20231231-5566-P_FND_EOQ_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=5566%2E2526796%2Ebzq1k5)
Alexandria traveled to Wentzille, MO with Rep. Cori Bush to support United Auto Workers striking for better pay, retirement benefits, and a fairer wage structure.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231231-1.0YiqFi&refcode=em20231231-5566-P_FND_EOQ_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&akid=5566%2E2526796%2Ebzq1k5)
**October 2023**
Alexandria and Team AOC welcomed over 300 children to our annual Halloween Party.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231231-1.0YiqFi&refcode=em20231231-5566-P_FND_EOQ_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=5566%2E2526796%2Ebzq1k5)
**November 2023**
Alexandria joined American Airlines flight attendants picketing at LaGuardia Airport, in her district. The flight attendants are in a protracted contract renegotiation, and are fighting for better pay and working conditions.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231231-1.0YiqFi&refcode=em20231231-5566-P_FND_EOQ_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=5566%2E2526796%2Ebzq1k5)
With your help, Alexandria and Team AOC distributed 700 turkeys to families around NYC who didn’t have one for Thanksgiving.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231231-1.0YiqFi&refcode=em20231231-5566-P_FND_EOQ_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=5566%2E2526796%2Ebzq1k5)
* * *
Thank you for making this year so special. None of this would be possible without your support.
We’re excited to continue growing and building with you in the year to come.
With thanks,
Team AOC

body:
Recruiting volunteers is a great first step — but it’s only the first step. Now we need to fully fund this massive volunteer effort.
#
Do you remember this?
Earlier this month, more than 13,000 volunteers (!!!) signed up to join our new voter registration campaign.
With no online or automatic voter registration in Texas, these volunteers are going to help us personally register our state’s 3+ million unregistered Democratic voters.
Recruiting this many volunteers has been a great first step — but it’s only the first step. Now we need to fund this massive undertaking.
[**We need 400 people to chip in $20 or more by midnight tonight to reach our $185,000 end-of-year fundraising goal. Can we count on you?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20231231-1.TwUUjY&refcode=ema20231231-237189&t=1&akid=237189%2E444211%2ENaRt1s)

**[DONATE $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20231231-1.TwUUjY&refcode=ema20231231-237189&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=237189%2E444211%2ENaRt1s)**
Your donation will ensure we have the resources we need in the months ahead to:
* Mail pre-stamped voter registration forms to every unregistered Democrat in Texas;
* Text and call each recipient to remind them to fill out their form and stick it in the mail;
* Train Volunteer Deputy Registrars (VDRs) who can personally register voters at their doors and in their communities; and
* Maintain year-long contact with voters to ensure they turn out on Election Day.

This is the work that’s necessary if we want to win elections up and down the ballot next year — [**so thank you for chipping in to this effort today.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20231231-1.TwUUjY&refcode=ema20231231-237189&t=22&akid=237189%2E444211%2ENaRt1s)

| Peter,

Our fundamental rights face unprecedented threats. The Supreme Court decision overturning Roe v. Wade rolled back decades of progress. After marching for reproductive rights during my college days, I never expected that the young women of today would have fewer rights to bodily autonomy than my generation.

The stakes couldn’t be higher in this election, and the choice couldn’t be clearer. An anti-choice Republican has entered this race, and his positions are not only out of line with Washington voters, they are downright dangerous.

As a mother and caretaker, I've relied on reproductive healthcare, understanding its vital importance. This fight for reproductive freedom is deeply personal to me.

As the Representative for Washington's 6th Congressional District, **I will unwaveringly defend reproductive rights and resist attempts to roll back progress.** But to bring that brighter future to every woman across the country, I need your help. Have I ever told you how I got into public service?

**I grew up the son of hardworking farmworkers.** My family lived in a small trailer in rural California where my brother and I shared a bed that in the daytime converted into a kitchen table.

When I was a teenager, I walked in the desert heat to different businesses asking them to invest in our community by investing in me and my dreams of a college education. I made them a promise that I would come back to the Coachella Valley to serve our community as a physician in return for their trust in me.

I not only returned to serve as an emergency physician, but eventually was elected to serve my community in Congress. For more than a decade, I’ve fought every day for my family, friends, and neighbors who dream the same dream my parents had for me.

**Those memories have come flooding back this year.** Because I’ve spent seemingly the entire week listening to the MAGA circus go round after round, attacking each other, blaming Democrats, and doing everything they can _EXCEPT_ serving the American people.

**And that’s part and parcel for the extreme MAGA caucus.** Instead of doing the hard work of reaching across the aisle to build consensus, they grind our government to a halt to play partisan games.

Please read this. | Hi there, before you dive into the New Year's celebration, I wanted to share a special moment with you — this photo that captures the essence of what we're fighting for. This is me and my daughter at a Breakfast with Santa event here on Long Island. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76189505/446904906/1307708269?noskip=true&refcode=ea.b39c5727-ffa7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ms=ea.b39c5727-ffa7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTU5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMzljNTcyNy1mZmE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hiwDw927ma211U_18sYFR4IPxhN6bl-wvKzT86A-0wo=) As we head into the new year — a critical election year — I’m reminded why I do this work. Why I serve in the New York State Senate. Why I’m running for Congress. Because I know that the choices we make today will shape the world that future generations will inherit. **That’s why I’ll never give up on the people of New York. But I can’t do it alone.** The most consequential election year in generations is just hours away. It also happens to be our campaign’s very last end-of-quarter deadline of the year. If you can, please contribute before midnight tonight to help us hit our goal: **[secure.actblue.com/donate/em_bax_kt_q4?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76189507/446904907/1307708269?refcode=ea.b39c5727-ffa7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ms=ea.b39c5727-ffa7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTU5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMzljNTcyNy1mZmE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hiwDw927ma211U_18sYFR4IPxhN6bl-wvKzT86A-0wo=)** We can't afford to pull any punches, team. The stakes are simply too high. Our battleground district here in New York could determine which party holds control of the House next year, and the experts are calling it a toss-up. In other words, if we want to defeat Anthony D'Esposito and give House Democrats a huge win, we need to crush our make-or-break goal tonight. We’re just about $637 short as we speak. Knowing this team, I am sure we can close the gap in no time, even with New Year's Eve ahead! Here’s a personalized link to make your contribution: **[secure.actblue.com/donate/em_bax_kt_q4?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76189509/446904908/1307708269?refcode=ea.b39c5727-ffa7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ms=ea.b39c5727-ffa7-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTU5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMzljNTcyNy1mZmE3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hiwDw927ma211U_18sYFR4IPxhN6bl-wvKzT86A-0wo=)** Thank you for your continued support, and Happy New Year to you and yours! body:
Chairman Jim Walsh highlights the final months of 2023, and what to look for as we head into the 2024 legislative and campaign seasons. | | |
---
| | [ ](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=070a728f71&e=6a281f566d)
---
| |
---
| Fellow Washington Republicans,

As the New Year quickly approaches, I want to offer a few reflections on the year that’s ending while looking forward to what lies ahead in 2024 for the WAGOP.

Here’s what we accomplished in 2023:
* At our State Committee meeting in August, WAGOP moved in a new direction—more outwardly focused, more active in taking control of media narratives and more determined to reach Washington voters fed up with crime and chaos and rising prices.

* Very quickly, we launched a project to test our best ideas about winning campaign strategies and tactics. WAGOP worked with 36 conservative school board candidates, from around the state, to help support their campaigns. **32 of those 36 candidates were elected in November!**

* While we were helping those conservative school board candidates win, we worked with several partner organizations to develop a coordinated ballot-collection program—yes, “**ballot harvesting** ”—to make sure that Republican voters vote. We used this program in targeted locations last November. And it worked.

* We drew public attention to shady, non-compliant practices by King County Elections and the WA Secretary of State in a way that legitimized our questions about election integrity in this state. **Even[ _The Seattle Times_ editorial board](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=c671697549&e=6a281f566d) grudgingly admitted that our questions are legit.**

* We’ve started a monthly series of “deep dive” policy discussion that explain in plain English but technical detail what WAGOP stands FOR. Restoring excellence in our K-12 public schools. Taking practical action to fight crime and rebuild safe neighborhoods. Get homeless people off the streets, instead of just talking about “homelessness” and wasting taxpayers’ money.

* We’ve secured and increased our fundraising efforts at all levels—grassroots, membership and major donors. This was most evident at our very successful Fall Fundraising Dinner, which saw a record crowd come out and contribute.

* We’ve developed in-house resources to build and expand boots-on-the-ground campaign infrastructure—and people—at the county and legislative-district committee levels. This includes a new Director of Development and Support, dedicated to helping county parties and legislative districts.

* WAGOP continues to receive recognition and support from the Republican National Committee. This is proven by WAGOP’s success in the RNC’s GROW Program and by strong relationships with the U.S. Senate and Congress campaign committees in D.C.

* WAGOP’s media presence has grown dramatically, both in traditional media and on social media. We’ve taken the space in MSM to re-define narratives on election integrity, repealing Inslee’s disastrous cap-and-trade tax scheme, tell the truth about crime rates in Washington, pushed back against lies about K-12 school performance and failed “Housing First” policies when it comes to homelessness.

* We’ve stepped into a leadership position among our partners in the legislature, business community and religious communities—building data resources and organizing the first polling efforts, looking forward to the next several election cycles.

* WAGOP, working with the Let’s Go WA and Restore WA organizations, qualified all Six Initiatives to Fix What’s Broken in Washington. By wide margins. Those initiatives—which would repeal Inslee’s cap-and-trade tax scheme, restore reasonable police pursuits, codify parental notification rights in state law and reform state tax policy—have strong bipartisan support. They could swing many voters to WAGOP’s side next November.

That last item is especially important, as the **Six Initiatives are likely to define politics in Washington throughout the year ahead.**

The Six are Initiatives to the Legislature, which means they will be presented to Olympia for consideration in the upcoming “short session” before they go to the people for votes in November 2024. For the first time decades, the Democrat majorities in the state legislature—not accustomed to playing defense on policy—don’t know what to do.
* Do they ignore the Six Initiatives, passing them on to the general election ballot in November—where they’re likely to motivate conservative voters and persuade independents?
* Do they agree with some of the Six Initiatives, so they become law immediately and aren’t on the November ballot? If that, which ones?
* Do they try to pass “alternatives” to the Six Initiatives, to confuse voters and possibly defend the broken status quo? Can they agree on what the “alternatives” would accomplish? Will the confusion scheme work?

The confused Democrats in the State House and Senate have looked to their masters in the executive branch for guidance and gotten nothing useful back. The current governor, a backbencher at heart, lacks any tactical political instincts or skills. He’s selfishly concerned only about protecting his disastrous cap-and-trade triple tax scheme, which his advisers tell him is his “legacy.”

The current state Attorney General, never a team player politically, is only concerned about his weak polling numbers in his bid to be the next governor. The current commissioner of public lands, secretary of state and schools superintendent aren’t leaders by nature and are embroiled in their own scandals and dramas.

**So, the field is set for the WAGOP to have more wins in 2024**. But none of this is guaranteed. We must work hard, put aside our minor differences, support each other and build our collective enthusiasm. That will translate into enthusiasm among Washington voters. And maximize our chances for success in 2024.

Specifically, here are WAGOP’s goals for 2024:
* Successfully hold the local precinct caucuses on January 13. The main measure of success here is simple: Get good people elected as delegates to the county conventions. But there are other goals, too. Attract new people to WAGOP. Give them a forum. Encourage new and existing activists about WAGOP policies and candidates. Energize them to stay engaged through November. And beyond.

* Support and coordinate county conventions that will take place at various times during the 12 weeks or so after the January caucuses. Again, the main metric for these conventions is to get good people elected as delegates to the State Convention. But, again, more will be happening. Delegates to the county conventions will be supporting certain candidates, promoting certain platform planks, pushing certain resolutions. As many as possible should be heard.

* Leverage the Six Initiatives to define and control as much of the agenda during the “short session” in Olympia as possible. Republicans are still in the minority at the State Capitol. But the Six Initiatives will give us the chance to keep the Democrats in an unfamiliar defensive position. This may yield some opportunities for parliamentary and legislative wins.

* Publicize and utilize the state’s U.S. Presidential Primary Election in March. Love it or hate it, the Presidential Primary will be a major opportunity to motivate and activate conservative voters in Washington. And it’s a big opportunity for WAGOP to gather critical voter data. Think of it as the biggest poll that happens all year.

* Have a great WAGOP State Convention in Spokane, April 18-20. This will be a State Convention unlike any other in years. The delegates (2,500 are planned) will nominate and endorse Republican candidates for the nine statewide executive positions (Gov, Lt Gov, etc.), the 10 U.S. Congress positions and the one U.S. Senate position on the ballot in 2024.

* Use our fundraising, data, media, and ground-game resources to support our nominated and endorsed candidates through the summer and fall. This will be where the real work comes in. We’ve learned from the last few cycles that TV ads alone don’t win elections. We need to be talking to WA voters by all means—including face-to-face.

* Coordinate with our partners in the federal and state legislative caucuses to win seats in D.C. and Olympia. The Third Congressional District race is certain to draw major national attention. But the Sixth Congressional seat is open. And the Eighth Congressional remains winnable. In Olympia, we will try to focus more tightly on legislative races we will win—instead of overpromising and under-delivering.

* Get as many of the Six Initiatives to the ballot in November—and then into law—as possible. All Six poll strongly, with bipartisan support. Democrats and left-wing activists know this and will be pouring tens of millions of dollars into nasty, negative media campaigns. (Silver lining: That’s money they won’t have to spend on statewide, congressional and legislative races!) We’ll have to fight hard to support what’s good.

* Win targeted statewide executive positions. Washington will always be a tough arena for Republican candidates, but much favors us in 2024. WAGOP will support a complete slate of candidates—but will focus especially on the Governor, State Attorney General, Commissioner of Public Lands, Secretary of State and Superintendent of Schools races.

**There’s so much more. But those are the main goals and points.**

We will change what people in Washington—especially, people in Seattle—think about Republicans. We will promote policies and laws that unite people and make their lives better. We will support and empower common-sense conservative candidates with the tools and resources to get elected. And stay elected.

The crux of my New Year’s message to all of you, my friends, is this: We are positioned to win in 2024. Nothing in politics or life is ever guaranteed. But WAGOP is set to win elections, not make excuses, moving forward.

Happy New Year!

name: Mandela Barnes
subject: I am respectfully asking for your $3 contribution ahead of our FEC deadline at midnight tonight
disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P
body:
#
[**Friend — I am reaching out one last time this year to respectfully ask you to make a $3 contribution to The Long Run.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-dec23.PPEU6P&refcode=em231231-1-t3&t=1&akid=5118%2E196590%2EZ7sKvK)
Tonight at midnight, we face our final FEC fundraising deadline of the year, and before I get ready to celebrate New Year's Eve with my friends and family, I wanted to make sure you knew why my request is so important.
Earlier this week, my team and I reached out to you about our $9,000 fundraising goal and how we cannot afford to come up short. Why? Because when we close the books on our final FEC deadline of 2023, we are required by law to publicly report our fundraising numbers. This is our final chance to publicly report our progress and show the strength and vigor this movement has behind it before the election year.
This goal was a steep one — one I wasn’t sure we could reach when my team told me the number. But this team has defied the odds before and will continue to reach new heights as long as we stand together. And you all did just that.
It started with Ashok from San Jose giving $3. Then Terry from Burlington pitched in their $5. And Elliot from Milwauke added their $25 too. And now they are counting on you to join them.
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to our movement ahead of our FEC fundraising deadline at midnight? We cannot reach our goals without your support.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-dec23.PPEU6P&refcode=em231231-1-t3&t=2&akid=5118%2E196590%2EZ7sKvK)
So far, this team has already made a substantial impact in races across the country, but there is a lot more work to do and we cannot slow down. The stakes in 2024 are high, and these campaigns will need much more funding and support than ever before.
And that’s where we come in. Because if we have your support, we can help strengthen change-making candidates from the get-go, so they have the funding to invest in the most crucial parts of their campaign — whether that be organizing efforts, TV ads, GOTV, or rallies. And the more funding they have, the more voters they can engage.
So, our work is critical to the success of many campaigns and we cannot leave any stone unturned.
Before we reach our final FEC deadline of 2023 at midnight tonight, I need to ask:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to The Long Run today? We will not be able to reach our fundraising goal without you by our side.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-dec23.PPEU6P&refcode=em231231-1-t3&t=5&akid=5118%2E196590%2EZ7sKvK)
Your support today will be critical to the success of our movement and many other campaigns in the coming year, so I hope you will join me today.
Happy New Year,
Mandela Barnes
[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-dec23.PPEU6P&refcode=em231231-1-t3&t=6&akid=5118%2E196590%2EZ7sKvK)

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you. We'd hate to see you go, but if you'd like you can [**unsubscribe here**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=7&akid=5118%2E196590%2EZ7sKvK). You can also [**sign up to receive fewer emails.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/fewer-emails/?source=em-footer&t=8&akid=5118%2E196590%2EZ7sKvK)
The Long Run PAC is funded by grassroots donors giving what they can, when they can. [**Make a contribution to The Long Run PAC today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/longrunpac-em-footer?refcode=em-footer&t=9&refcode2=5118_196590_Z7sKvK&akid=5118%2E196590%2EZ7sKvK)
Submit this form to [**update your contact information.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/update-contact-info/?source=em-footer&t=10&akid=5118%2E196590%2EZ7sKvK)
Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P.O. Box 597
Milwaukee, WI 53201, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee.

name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: Wishes For 2024!
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Dear Friend,
I hope this message finds you and your family housed and in great health. As this year comes to a close, I can’t help but reflect on my professional and personal accomplishments in 2023. To be honest, I expected life to be a little calmer than it was in 2022 and frankly, a bit slower as we geared up for our campaign in 2024.
As I look back, there is one photo that I think best captures my personal and professional successes in 2023. It’s a photo of my daughter enjoying a babyccino (there is no coffee) at Elementary Coffee in Harrisburg, PA during a strategy meeting for my campaign. What you can’t tell is that she was just as present as everyone else during the intense discussions about AI use in campaigning. In fact, I remember noticing how having a toddler interrupt conversations to introduce “rabbit” to an AI software engineer and the founders of a new tech startup didn’t derail anyone from doing their jobs.
That ability to focus on the work that needs to get done has increasingly become one of my measures of the competence of the partners I work with and those I want to represent me. While working on some of the most cutting-edge technology of our lifetimes, the group I was meeting with was fully capable of being nurturing to my daughter while having in-depth conversations about tech, policy and values. I think that is simultaneously what is amazing about this story, and what we should expect from our public servants.
I didn’t know at the start of 2023 that I would be making campaign world history [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/12/12/democratic-campaign-ai-caller-00131180] , With that history-making moment came a lot of hours of hard work and focus. Let’s just say that I ended 2023 ready for a nap. As the year comes to a close–and I take my nap–I cannot wait to get to work in 2024 and finish what we started by defeating Scott Perry in November.
I close 2023 grateful for all that we’ve done. As I head into 2024, there is a world I wish for my daughter –and all of you–in 2024. I wish for:
Peace on earth!
Healthy food for our families
Habitable and loving housing
Clean air and water
The ability to make decisions over our own bodies and healthcare.
Time for leisure and fitness
...and of course, more naps, lots of naps.
With 2024 just hours away, will you make a contribution to our campaign to help us reach our online fundraising goal before midnight tonight? CLICK HERE to DONATE NOW! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Happy New Year!
With gratitude,
Shamaine

Peter – We know today is New Year's Eve, so we'll keep this short. Earlier this week, we told you about our goal to raise $10,000 by midnight tonight. The stakes for 2024 couldn’t be higher–Arizona has already been named a battleground state by many forecasters and Democrats’ Senate majority hangs in the balance. We’ve been talking about replacing Sinema for more than two years now... but the time has finally come. 2024 is here. It’s now or never. The time has come to give Sinema the boot and elect the leadership Arizona deserves. Reaching our goal means that we'll be able to move ahead with our plans to oust Sinema from the Senate without compromise. clean_body: ⏰⏰ Countdown is on! The countdown is on to make a gift that will endure for centuries. Peter, happy New Year’s Eve! It’s incredible to think that the gift you make before this countdown clock hits zero will leave a legacy lasting decades – even centuries – powering growth in redwood forests. Here’s what your gift to the Redwood Land Fund makes possible: Safeguard redwood forests and the surrounding lands needed to nurture them. | ---|--- | Power our work of restoring logged areas and surrounding land to build a future for ancient forests. ---|--- Create and reimagine redwoods adventures to connect all people to the peace and beauty of the California redwoods through a network of world-class parks and inspirational outreach and education programs. | ---|--- I’m passionate about my work at the League because of the profound, long-term impact we can achieve together. While I may not live a hundred years to witness these forests thriving again, it’s a heck of a legacy to work toward. Thanks for joining us. | Ben Blom Director of Stewardship and Restoration ---|--- P.S. * | | | | ---|---|---|--- Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States tel:415-362-2352 | |

| | We have only a few hours left in 2023. So, here's the plan for 2024. Next year, we're going to build an even bigger, more powerful grassroots movement to advance our progressive priorities by flipping the House, defending the Democratic Senate Majority, and winning one of the most important Presidential elections in our lifetimes. We all know what's on the line in the next election, and we all know what will happen if Trump and his MAGA extremists regain total control of our government. **They'll corrupt our courts, give even bigger tax breaks to corporate polluters and billionaires, and restrict our civil rights.** But we also know we have a message that wins elections, and we have the momentum going into 2024. We know our democracy doesn't belong to big corporations, special interests, or the ultra-wealthy. We’re only a few hours away from our final end-of-quarter deadline of 2023, and right now we’re still running $1,933 short of our goal.

I wouldn’t be asking for your support if it wasn’t critically important. body:
**** Since they took over the majority just one short year ago, my colleagues across the aisle have put their dysfunction and obstruction on full display.

The chaos and partisan games are exhausting, and the lack of serious solutions for our families, seniors, and hard-working Americans is inexcusable.

_And what a contrast this past year has been to our Democratic-led Congresses – when we used our time in the majority to lower healthcare costs for millions, stand up for our Democratic allies around the world, and make historic investments in our environment and infrastructure. Americans are counting on Congress to get back to legislating and governing in a serious manner._

**And how this team shows up today for our FEC end-of-year public filing deadline will set us up for success for the start of 2024 – or set us back if we’re unable to hit our goals.[If you’re able, can I count on you to donate now so we don’t fall behind?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76195139/446914214/979907179?amount=24&refcode=12312023_md_eoy_fr_11&refcode2=3e53564d-04a8-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZTUzNTY0ZC0wNGE4LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GyPaG034EC1TIqyXJS5aDpBNwRkbFT-Adt9osCo5kvk=)**

subject: About tonight’s end-of-year deadline
body:
I’ve been thinking back on when I launched Courier. When we first got started...

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76198885/446918518/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTljNmU0OGQtMDZhOC1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=S_qF8ovWsOc2iPxJBo2wrvUlqC9GW9f24AeV3w6Y8CM=&emci=e2c6e48d-06a8-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&emdi=e9c6e48d-06a8-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=14016711)
Hey Peter, it's Tara McGowan — Founder and Publisher of Courier Newsroom. As another year comes to a close, I’ve been thinking back to when I launched Courier, and how far we’ve come since then.
For far too long, we’ve watched mainstream news organizations prioritize profit over good journalism.
First, in 2016, Donald Trump won the White House, in part by using mainstream media outlets to sow division and spread lies, hate, and conspiracy theories.
Then, in 2020, right-wing disinformation campaigns about election security and fraud spread unchecked and **directly led** to the violence we all witnessed at the Capitol on January 6th.
I founded Courier on the belief that the best antidote to the spread of lies and conspiracy theories is increasing the volume of good, factual information in the online spaces where people actually get their news, like inboxes or social media feeds.
**Together, we achieved so much this year, and I’m grateful that you’ve been a part of this journey. As 2023 comes to a close, and with the 2024 election on the horizon, my belief in the urgency and impact of our work is stronger than ever.**
[**We’ve got big plans for 2024, from growing our existing newsrooms to branching out into new states — but our ability to put those plans into action depends in part on us reaching our end-of-year fundraising goal tonight. Will you chip in $5 today to help us raise the final resources we need to hit our $15,000 goal?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76198887/446918521/-152327154?refcode=em20231231&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTljNmU0OGQtMDZhOC1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=S_qF8ovWsOc2iPxJBo2wrvUlqC9GW9f24AeV3w6Y8CM=)
_**The stakes for 2024 are high, Peter.**_ Since 2020, Trump and MAGA Republicans’ rhetoric has only become more violent, more authoritarian, and more untethered from reality. It’s not an understatement to say that there is a possibility that a literal fascist could be re-elected to the White House.
**Unfortunately, there’s still very little evidence that mainstream media organizations have learned from their mistakes of the past. **
Rather than calling out lies and conspiracy theories for what they are, mainstream media has remained steadfast in an out-of-date model that covers “both sides” and platforms professional liars and grifters who do not have the best interest of our democracy at heart.
What’s more, is that as local newsrooms continue to close across the country, leaving more and more Americans in “news deserts” or communities without reliable, trustworthy local news.
As a result, right-wing bad actors have a huge opening to further spread misinformation to reach a much broader audience.
**But because of the tireless efforts of our journalists, along with your generous support, we have been able to fight back in 10 battleground states across the country. And we don’t plan on slowing down anytime soon. Because democracy is worth fighting for. **
**But our battle against bad information isn’t over though.** To win this fight, we have to keep fighting back with good information every day — all of the way into the 2024 presidential election and beyond.
[**To do that, we’ll need to hire even more journalists, expand into new battleground states, and reach our $15,000 end-of-year goal. Your support makes all the difference in this fight, so will you pitch in $5 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76198888/446918522/-1127575123?refcode=em20231231&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTljNmU0OGQtMDZhOC1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=S_qF8ovWsOc2iPxJBo2wrvUlqC9GW9f24AeV3w6Y8CM=)
**[Chip in $5 ➡️](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76198889/446918523/-152327154?refcode=em20231231&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTljNmU0OGQtMDZhOC1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=S_qF8ovWsOc2iPxJBo2wrvUlqC9GW9f24AeV3w6Y8CM=)**
As always, thanks so much,
Tara McGowan
_Founder & Publisher
Courier Newsroom_

Team,
You’ve heard us (and every other campaign) talk about the importance of the FEC deadline coming up tonight at midnight. Let us take you behind the scenes on what this deadline really means:
At the end of each fiscal quarter, federal candidates are required to publicly report how much money they’ve raised, as well as how much they have in the bank. These numbers essentially provide a glimpse into how well a particular campaign is performing, and there is always a last-minute push for contributions in the period leading up to the deadline. (Hence, this email.)
In this last-minute push, campaigns tend to pull out all the stops when it comes to raising money. Some tactics try to scare the heck out of you; some are full of despair; and some can be downright manipulative.
Trust us, we don’t like these tactics either — but fundraising around a deadline does actually tend to be pretty effective. Unfortunately, creating a sense of urgency and continuing to up the stakes does actually get more folks to contribute. It’s gotten to the point that some campaigns will make up fake deadlines, fake consequences, and emergency-like energy in order to continue to drive that sense of urgency.
But that approach has never been Elissa's style. So rather than giving you a completely made-up emergency or trying to convince you that the sky is falling, we just lay our cards out on the table, as we’re doing now.
Our goal is to give you the full context as to why these (actual) deadlines are important and try to give you a window in our race, and the whole process of running for Senate.
Tonight's FEC deadline is one of our best chances to show what a formidable opponent Team Slotkin is. Friends and competitors alike watch these numbers and make critical decisions for the road ahead.

With all eyes on Georgia in 2024, the GA Dems need to build the most robust voter protection and outreach program that we have ever seen, and the earlier that we can build that program, the more effective it will be. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = = = = = = Peter, I wouldn’t be coming to you right now if I didn’t believe deeply in this mission. Georgia has a long history of voter suppression and denying access to the ballot box. Just this year, a federal judge ruled that Georgia’s Republican-drawn congressional and legislative districts violated the Voting Rights Act and diluted the power of Black voters. We need to do everything we can to provide Georgia voters the support they need. = All eyes are on what happens in Georgia next year. We can’t afford to fall short. – Stacey | | Paid for by the Democratic Party of Georgia. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.georgiademocrat.org | Democratic Party of Georgia P.O. BOX 89202 Atlanta, GA 30312 United States

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=35531%2E3422442%2E5gqV8u)
Hey Derek!
Before the new year, I wanted to make sure you saw my email. Anything you can give before 2024 will help us reach the voters we need to win this competitive primary!
Here’s that link, and thanks in advance. I hope you have a happy new year!
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231231-1?refcode=20231231-1](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231231-1?refcode=EMAO23_1_KPR_20231231_V1_F&refcode2=35531_3422442_5gqV8u&akid=35531%2E3422442%2E5gqV8u)**
_\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: "Katie Porter" <info@katieporter.com>
Date: Sat, Dec 31, 2023 at 11:43 AM
Subject: personal update
To: Derek [dpwillis67@gmail.com]_
Derek, I wanted to reach out personally to share some updates on the campaign.
While earlier polls showed us leading or just barely trailing Adam Schiff, **two December polls show Republican Steve Garvey in second place, with us in third.**
These were the first polls to show us behind our Republican opponent. Because only the top two candidates, regardless of party, advance from the primary to the November general election, **we can’t let Republican Steve Garvey be the reason we fail to advance.**
With ballots going out February 5th to all California voters, these next few weeks are critical to ensure I can keep running to represent California in the U.S. Senate.
**Our end of quarter fundraising deadline is 12/31,** and this is a marker for our campaign and the momentum we’re building. But we have to ramp up our fundraising if we’re going to win.
A super PAC has already spent $1 million on ads supporting another candidate in this race, and Adam Schiff has outraised us every quarter so far. I am the only candidate in this race who doesn’t accept corporate PAC or federal lobbyist money, so every dollar I raise comes from my supporters like you.
If you can contribute before the end of the year, I would be so appreciative! Anything you can give today will ensure I have the opportunity to build momentum and communicate with undecided voters across California before the competitive March primary.
**You can make a contribution here:[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231231-1?refcode=20231231-1](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231231-1?refcode=EMAO23_1_KPR_20231231_V1_F&refcode2=35531_3422442_5gqV8u&akid=35531%2E3422442%2E5gqV8u)**
Thank you Derek, for your past and continued support! You’re an important part of Team Porter, and I am grateful you’re on my side.
Katie

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=EMAO23_1_KPR_20231231_V1_F&t=2&refcode2=35531_3422442_5gqV8u&akid=35531%2E3422442%2E5gqV8u)**
