name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: What you told me
body:
Democracy Defenders are making their voices heard, and I'm here for it!

| | |
---
Friend, we asked what your priorities for 2024 were. You know mine by now. I'm all-in to support pro-democracy candidates in Michigan and ensure our elections are safer and more transparent than ever. But I can't do it alone. That's why we've got a network of Democracy Defenders around the state ready to roll up their sleeves and do the hard work of protecting our democracy. We got responses from all across Michigan, and I'm still poring through them, but it's clear there are three themes you all are watching for headed into 2024: 1) **Safeguarding our elections and ensuring every eligible voter has the ability to cast a vote (and that they're counted!)** Jan from Houghton said she's worried about "election interference" and Chris from Grand Rapids wants to make sure everyone's vote counts. 2) **Supporting the elected officials and candidates doing the hard work to make our democracy stronger.** When we announced Michigan Legacy PAC's key endorsements starting in November, so many of you stepped up and helped support them. Michael from Novi asked us who else he should keep an eye on in the close House races next year -- my team and I will be sure to tell you where you can do the most good. 3) **Making sure our democratic legacy is protected for future generations.** Yes, I know "Legacy" is part of the name of the organization I founded to help pro-democracy leaders. But if you ask people like Sandy from Marquette, she wants to make sure that what we're starting here isn't just a flash in the pan and that democracy "shouldn't ever be at stake again". That's our goal! [**I'm re-energized to do the hard work next year, and I know you are too. Thank you all for making your voices heard. If you haven't yet, will you please consider making a contribution to help us grow our network of Democracy Defenders?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76206923/446933488/-2134816095?refcode=Em123123&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWQwMjVlYS0wZWE4LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KNmOynKioQhjrgfwoN8WLxB98oEghFcA1SdDDYkvqEA=) Thank you for your support and have a happy New Year! -Jocelyn [**PS - there's still time to take the survey. name: LCV Membership Team
subject: MIDNIGHT MATCH DEADLINE: Peter: Unclaimed
body:
Time sensitive

Peter - our Membership Drive deadline is a few days away, and we're reaching out because we haven't heard from you yet (renew your membership here and your contribution will be tripled https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ebDKc930- ).

The truth is your membership matters, and it's particularly critical right now.

Here's the situation: Earlier this month, Senator Joe Manchin backed away from a climate deal after months of negotiations, choosing to side with Big Oil and Republicans. It leaves the deal one vote short -- stalling any real action in Congress for now.

In response, we're redoubling our efforts on pushing the White House to act decisively on climate. The Biden administration has massive amounts of power to curb climate pollution - but that will only happen if the environmental movement makes it happen.

Right now, we're facing a critical test: the Biden administration is weighing a plan to block all new oil and gas drilling leases on public waters.

This could be huge -- and a decision is coming. Right now, we're organizing volunteers from all over the country to flood the administration with letters, pressuring Biden to hold to his promises.

Peter -- it's your membership support that makes victory possible here. But we have to do more. A group of donors has put together a fund to triple match every contribution before Sunday's membership deadline:

Can we count on your support? Claim your membership now - it only takes $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv.

The ban on new oil and gas leases is the first of many huge environmental decisions, Peter. And right now, we're pushing for serious action on so many fronts -- including:
Setting tight standards for power plants and other major emitters of climate pollution
Placing strict limits on air pollution to safeguard all communities Expediting requirements of 100% tailpipe pollution-free new cars by 2035 and trucks by 2040
Protecting communities from hazardous and super-polluting methane Conserving 30% of our public lands and waters by 2030 Declaring a climate emergency - and so much more. The best way you can help win each and every one of these fights right now is to claim your LCV membership - all it takes is a gift of $5 or more. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you, thank you, thank you, Peter. This is such a critical moment for the environment, and we're so fortunate to have you on the team.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. subject: Before the ball drops…
body:
Our final goal before the New Year
Hey Peter,
Happy New Years Eve, I can’t believe it’s almost 2024. 😳 We’ve officially made it to the big election year!
Tonight is also a big moment for our campaign. Our final end-of-year fundraising deadline is at 9 PT/12 ET and I really need your help because we’re still over 100 donations away from our goal.
You can [make a donation here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76207523/446935211/597931340?&refcode=E5597-20231231-NewYearsEve-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTk2ZjQwNmEtMGZhOC1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mwLw75Ym8cj4xRpT-N0QX5pcyptVLwu2pYc5lsOigtI=) \- and here is why I need your support:
Right now, we’re on the verge of sending in our final fundraising report of the year to the Federal Election Commission. Last quarter, my opponent was the #2 GOP raiser in the country. We can’t afford to miss our goal or else I will be outraised for the first time since I was elected to Congress.
We also have to be prepared for an onslaught of outside spending. Republicans have already spent more than six figures on attacks against me this year (including a disgusting new hit piece this week...) and it’s only going to get worse in the new year. That’s why tonight’s deadline is so important.
So before the ball drops tonight, I’m asking: Will you be one of the final 100 supporters I need to chip in so we can reach our end-of-year goal and keep the momentum in this race? It’s a pivotal moment for us in this toss-up seat!
I’ll leave my personal link here to say thanks in the New Year: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCA-09-Email-Dec2023-FR-December?refcode2=Peter](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76207524/446935212/597931340?&refcode=E5597-20231231-NewYearsEve-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTk2ZjQwNmEtMGZhOC1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mwLw75Ym8cj4xRpT-N0QX5pcyptVLwu2pYc5lsOigtI=)
See you in 2024!

Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) arrests of criminals
increased in fiscal year 2023, but remained significantly lower
compared to the Trump administration, according to an agency report
published Friday. ICE had roughly 3,000 criminal arrests in fiscal

None of the work we accomplished in 2023 would’ve been possible without the support of DFLers like you, [name]. In the year ahead we will be working to grow Minnesota’s economy by growing the middle class, as well as campaigning to protect and expand our House DFL majority.

From my family to yours, Happy New Year.

Can we go a little deeper than just saying HAPPY NEW YEAR? Although I certainly pray that for you and all those who are connected to you.
But just for a moment, can we go a level deeper? For all of us who are going into 2024 with those who we entered into 2023 with...then truly, let us PRAISE THE LORD!!! And let us put in the work this year to take no one and no opportunity for granted.
Like many of you, I've lost important people in my life over the years - dear people, amazing people who wrote on the fabric of my life. I am who I am, in many regards, because of their existence. For so many of you who are entering 2024 with fewer people than you entered 2023 with, I sincerely pray for God's peace to fill your heart and eyes. I pray that you can see above and beyond to those who are still with you on this day. I've learned that life is a series of choices, and this will be one of them.
**A quick note:**
I held my first of many, Zoom face times with several of you last night. It. was. awesome. My heart literally felt a little happier...a little lighter. It's amazing how that works.
We are *not* alone, if we make that choice. In my line of work, I get to meet many people who are like us...who think like us and who are good people. My hope is to create more spaces like I did last night where we can connect, laugh, encourage, pray for one another...and know that we are not alone.
Again, my heart was made a little happier last night (...and who doesn't need a little more 'happy'). I will host another Zoom call soon. I hope to see you there.
Blessings and HAPPY NEW YEAR!

| Peter,

We are down to the wire, with only 12 hours left until our end-of-quarter deadline. This is your final opportunity to stand with us and make a real impact in supporting our military and securing our borders. [Will you join us in this crucial fight?](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=ec8136b76e&e=273c9a71fb)

As a veteran and candidate for Congress, I am fully committed to ensuring that they have the support, resources, and respect they deserve. Your generous contribution will help us advocate for increased funding for our military, ensuring they have the necessary resources for training, equipment, and healthcare.

At the same time, our nation faces a border crisis that threatens our national security and the stability of our communities. By supporting our campaign, you will help us champion legislation that prioritizes border security, enforcing our immigration laws and protecting our citizens.

Time is of the essence. [ Every dollar counts, and your donation will directly impact our efforts to support our military and secure our borders.](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=7fccc2f9a7&e=273c9a71fb)

Hey there, Janelle’s Finance Team here. We hate to throw a bunch of numbers at you on a Sunday, but we want to make sure you have a clear picture of what we’re dealing with right now:

| | I wanted to check in one more time before our end-of-year deadline to explain the stakes of the 2024 elections and why your support is so important. **Our Democratic Senate majority has a lot to be proud of — from confirming hundreds of progressive judges to passing historic legislation to create jobs, boost clean energy, and bring down the cost of prescription drugs — but all progress will grind to a halt if Republicans flip the chamber next year.** Let's be frank about the playing field for 2024:
* Democrats are on the offense in the battle for control of the House and can re-take it by flipping just 5 seats in districts that Joe Biden carried by significant margins
* However, we face a historically daunting Senate map and need to hold seats in 5 states that each voted at least once for Donald Trump

[**In 2024, I'll be organizing to defend our Senate majority and advance our progressive values wherever we can. If our grassroots movement is going to succeed, we need to be building the groundwork**** _now_****. So please donate $3 before we ring in the new year tonight.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76213572/446950232/-2044921950?refcode=2023-12-31-eoq&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=8df78891-18a8-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZGY3ODg5MS0xOGE4LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZKrCbKBuHc9pIPqI-Tcr0sMTr2a-Q5eUy7nFC0q82Ys=) I have high hopes for what the next Democratic trifecta could accomplish. We can secure civil liberties and voting rights. We can create a wave of affordable housing. We can fix the damage wrought by the right-wing Supreme Court. We can expand health care access, and make higher education an achievable reality for _all_ Americans. **A strong, progressive government has a tremendous ability to do good for the American people.** We've seen that in everything from our infrastructure law to our COVID relief efforts to the CHIPS Act to the Inflation Reduction Act. And should we hold the majority come 2025, there is so much more we can do to build on our progress. But first, we have to pull out all the stops and ensure that we have the resources to counter GOP spending across the board. I will always be on the side of progress and justice, and in 2024 I hope to have you as part of our movement. Our Democratic Senate majority has a lot to be proud of — from confirming hundreds of progressive judges to passing historic legislation to create jobs, boost clean energy, and bring down the cost of prescription drugs — but all progress will grind to a halt if Republicans flip the chamber next year. Let's be frank about the playing field for 2024: Democrats are on the offense in the battle for control of the House and can re-take it by flipping just 5 seats in districts that Joe Biden carried by significant margins However, we face a historically daunting Senate map and need to hold seats in 5 states that each voted at least once for Donald Trump = I have high hopes for what the next Democratic trifecta could accomplish. We can secure civil liberties and voting rights. We can create a wave of affordable housing. We can fix the damage wrought by the right-wing Supreme Court. We can expand health care access, and make higher education an achievable reality for all Americans. A strong, progressive government has a tremendous ability to do good for the American people. We've seen that in everything from our infrastructure law to our COVID relief efforts to the CHIPS Act to the Inflation Reduction Act. And should we hold the majority come 2025, there is so much more we can do to build on our progress. But first, we have to pull out all the stops and ensure that we have the resources to counter GOP spending across the board. | | Dear Patriot,

---
This is my final email to you of 2023.
---
I couldn’t possibly conclude the year without __first__ THANKING you for all of your support.
---
Because of you, we were able to prevail against the most vicious political attacks in the history of our country.
---
Crooked Joe and his Democrat accomplices tried to systematically ELIMINATE their leading opponent – ME – through wrongful arrests, indictments, lawsuits, sham trials, and a mugshot. And then, when each of their attacks failed, they did the _unthinkable_ and simply **REMOVED** my name from the ballot.
---
These were _fear tactics_ designed to intimidate _you_ out of pursuing our noble mission to restore power to the hardworking citizens of our country.
---
But our year-end report – filed with the Federal Election Commission – will show that these fear tactics not only failed to stop us, they AWAKENED the full spirit of the Silent Majority.
---
_**Tonight at 11:59 P.M. is our last chance to give 2023 all we’ve got before we close the books on this dark year and officially enter 2024 – the most critical election year in American history.**_
---
_With your support, we will post a massive grassroots fundraising haul, proving that NOTHING can intimidate the American people!_
---
**So, I was checking to see who hasn’t donated yet before tonight’s Federal Election Commission deadline – and as of the last time I checked the roster, I didn’t see your name.**
---
But please do __**NOT**__ get me wrong...
---
_...I am certainly not trying to make you feel pressured into making a contribution._
---
If you can’t donate right now because of the sinister Crook in the White House who’d rather spend all day thinking about how he can JAIL his leading opponent than lift a single finger to help our _own_ citizens, then just hit the back button, and go about your day. _I mean it._
---
**I’m only reaching out, because I know that so many of our donors choose to wait until the final day of the month to help us reach our fundraising goal. In fact, it’s always our BIGGEST day of the month for that reason. People must see the clock ticking down to midnight and decide this is the moment to spring into action._And this time, it’s the FINAL day of the year – so we’re expecting a massive surge!_**
---

1. On December 15th, 2023, the momentous news arrived: I was officially**running unopposed** in the upcoming 2024 election for the U.S. House in Texas’s 8th district.
2. The moment I **formally filed my candidacy** for TX-8 was more than a procedural step; it symbolized a commitment to serve and elevate the voices of our diverse community.
3. By volunteering alongside remarkable individuals and engaging with the vibrant tapestry of people across District 8, I didn't just meet my **outreach goals** —I exceeded them. Each interaction widened my understanding, offering profound insight into what truly matters to our community, and allowing me to address the needs of everyone in TX-8.
4. Thanks to the support of everyone who has donated to my campaign, I have successfully met my **fundraising goals** for the year 2023, allowing me to cover my filing fee. The generosity and belief in the campaign showcased the strength of our community, reaffirming my commitment to progress and representation for all in District 8.
5. The ability to **establish a network** of supportive and remarkable individuals within District 8 and across the United States has been an incredible asset to our campaign. I am grateful to each person who has extended their support, whether through words of encouragement, volunteering their time, or contributing in various ways.

As we close out the year, I can't help but reflect on the incredible diversity that we are fortunate to have within our district and the abundance of support I have received from around the nation. District 8 stands as a testament to the richness of various cultures, traditions, and stories interwoven into the fabric of our daily lives. The depth of our community, often unseen by many, serves as the heartbeat of our district, shaping our collective identity in profound ways. Representing such a vibrant and multicultural district is an honor beyond words, and I'm thankful for the contributions of everyone in our community.
Additionally, the abundance of support from individuals across the nation has been nothing short of inspiring. It's a testament to the belief in our shared vision, transcending geographical boundaries, and reaffirming the importance of our collective voice in shaping a better future.
Looking ahead to my journey in Washington, my commitment remains to advocating for every corner of our district. Embracing the distinct perspectives and needs every person brings is fundamental. I am committed to uniting our community, ensuring that every voice, every story, is not merely heard but supported. Your support has been the guiding force of this endeavor, and I am deeply indebted to the support and trust extended by individuals like yourself.
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=bd0f806332&e=a2a46ff12c)
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=2239b8dcd6&e=a2a46ff12c)
— Laura

When I launched my Substack newsletter in the summer of 2022, I wasn't exactly sure how it would take shape. Having championed legitimate and humane alternatives to the brutal and ecocidal bipartisan policy framework in Washington as a congressional candidate for the previous six years, I knew that I wanted to continue speaking truth to power and exposing hypocrisy and corruption.
Little did I know how much grist for my proverbial mill current events would come to offer.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2a1febe6-abe0-4eb1-bab0-ece0f8790524?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Image by D. Bjorn, [licensed](https://substack.com/redirect/f9b4b5dc-fab5-4867-bda4-98aaf7d327d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) through Creative Commons
My observations this year covered a wide range of subjects, from genocide in Gaza to global climate agreements, dysfunction and corruption in Congress, the deference to yet another Pentagon coverup revealing effective state control over American journalists, and more.
I write to inform readers routinely misled by co-opted journalists and editors. You can help by sharing this post on social media networks, and with your friends.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=140228383&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQwMjI4MzgzLCJpYXQiOjE3MDQwNTQ2MzEsImV4cCI6MTcwNjY0NjYzMSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.hVMbTl3HpU-cTd0exZik4ZfzpcMxH2v9bMnbl7K8SW4)
Several of those themes unfortunately recurred over the course of the year. My stories included:
### **The 2024 presidential election**
* An explanation of why the several [criminal prosecutions targeting former president--and aspiring tyrant--Donald Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/ef37a7ed-2ff8-437b-87c9-bbfecae6af21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) could ironically help return him to the White House (April)
* An examination of why [Dr. Cornel West](https://substack.com/redirect/df196e24-04b5-4097-8429-0d6ce98de46f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) poses such a threat to the Democratic Party given its relentless gaslighting of the racial minorities on whose support it relies (June)
* A reflection on the [farcical presidential election of 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/0fe07507-d602-432e-986f-a5612da4ccd9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (July)

### **War & militarism**
* A plea for [international recognition for a renowned military whistleblower](https://substack.com/redirect/d0794eaf-8064-4eb7-99d6-8ffb7d8af550?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who played a crucial role in ending Washington's fraudulent and failed war on Vietnam (March)
* An exploration of Star Wars, and [George Lucas' profound symbolism addressing militarism](https://substack.com/redirect/3242bd47-43e6-446d-887e-59e90ce8a084?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that most viewers unfortunately ignored (May)
* A review of [how Congress bends over backwards to enable the Pentagon's continuing corruption, fraud, waste, and abuse](https://substack.com/redirect/7c7a5571-873b-4058-8d9e-b671efbabd45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the American public (September)
* A dark turn in the Middle East, published two days after [the October 7 attacks that prompted Israel to escalate its longstanding human rights abuses](https://substack.com/redirect/a4171ad7-b6f2-48ae-98b9-299a73bf6451?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Palestine (October)
* The [death of Senator Dianne Feinstein](https://substack.com/redirect/2825677e-0ca7-45fd-94f8-45c4fb3dc58c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and how California Governor Gavin Newsom failed the test it presented (October)
* A review of [congressional unanimity supporting the military industrial complex](https://substack.com/redirect/2289bd7b-3ff0-455c-a088-07626b54c602?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) despite the illusion of partisan rancor (October)

### **Depicting grassroots movements challenging Washington**
* A national [movement for peace](https://substack.com/redirect/66fcbd82-4907-4efc-b01c-6d161070ed0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that aimed to challenge the preventable proxy war in Ukraine (February)
* An examination of [the resurgent labor movement](https://substack.com/redirect/39b2e85f-17a3-48e1-8e1d-8c40b366c561?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and efforts by Democrats to limit, gaslight, and co-opt it (September)
* An explanation of [how We, the People, could unplug Washington's war machine](https://substack.com/redirect/443c2c88-6f19-4a32-84b0-5b2f55605dae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the heels of historic labor mobilization across the United States (November)
* A review of [the global movement for peace](https://substack.com/redirect/c980fa70-ac79-4303-8679-28860745d46e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) challenging Washington's support for Israel's genocidal campaign to displace Palestinians from Gaza (November)

### **Congressional failure and bipartisan corruption**
* [Failures by congressional Democrats](https://substack.com/redirect/5dd0ba43-635f-4d21-99af-be53704d4075?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to demonstrate the same assertiveness as their counterparts across the aisle (January)
* Opportunities for right-wing Republicans created by [Democrats openly embracing conflicts of interest](https://substack.com/redirect/af445587-275d-4f25-b320-eb9d14b11ab3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and unconstitutional self-enrichment through insider trading, also released as a [podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/e2464413-72e4-48a5-afa2-d853e71a5a65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (January)
* An analysis of congressional entrenchment explaining why [thoughtful concerns about bipartisan gerontocracy](https://substack.com/redirect/b9291a26-abfa-43fa-a1d8-c2d4e7453e8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ultimately miss the mark and overlook factors contributing more to the problem (September)
* How [the removal of GOP Speaker of the House Kevin McCarthy](https://substack.com/redirect/b6244803-8fa3-409e-8bd7-5907d442e596?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) revealed the weakness of Democrats in Congress who accept, rather than challenge, the corruption of their own party's leadership (October)
* A discussion of [why congressional dysfunction could be a great thing for the world](https://substack.com/redirect/71486e2a-1af8-4b06-9f02-5b14a4533370?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), even as it indicates the erosion of democracy in America (October)
* An analysis of [the new Speaker of the House](https://substack.com/redirect/6bd06830-004d-4af2-8fad-5276ef26b34e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and why Mike Johnson is poised to wreak such havoc across Washington (October)
* An examination of [how the Israeli genocide in Gaza reveals the state of democracy in America](https://substack.com/redirect/745d0f60-789e-43bf-ac54-0df9e089bc63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (November)
* An analysis of [Washington's new McCarthyism](https://substack.com/redirect/e5d0cb1e-c6c3-418a-8a28-c8bcf305f842?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and institutional efforts to suppress and demonize voices speaking the truth in the face of a continuing genocide (November)
* An [admission](https://substack.com/redirect/1eb682ff-1352-4864-aa3b-cbdeec8dff3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that I got it wrong when [predicting](https://substack.com/redirect/6bd06830-004d-4af2-8fad-5276ef26b34e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Congress would prove unable to stop another government shutdown (November)

### **The erosion of journalism and the co-optation of editors**
* Failures by journalists that in turn emboldened [corrupt local officials](https://substack.com/redirect/0c3c28a1-2992-4f50-90e2-7af16f73a5b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who benefit from (both institutional and, in one case, their own) racism (January)
* My [election integrity lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/5c175341-7f21-421f-a293-70ac869f4abb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against the Hearst Corporation and San Francisco Chronicle, which continues in the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals and aims to hold editors and journalists accountable for documented racism and betraying journalistic ethics in order insulate a corrupt oligarch from accountability (January)
* The bizarre phenomenon of [comedians depicting the White House](https://substack.com/redirect/ef426e42-2074-4316-a5fd-323e9f4f8c0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more accurately than self-congratulating journalists punching down in retaliation (February)
* Journalists finally showing up to cover the [dire constitutional threat posed by illegal government surveillance](https://substack.com/redirect/809c2e44-5907-4265-ab3d-b1cd01915250?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), decades after advocates raised our concerns and long after ignoring my congressional campaign that aimed to offer the public a chance to influence these suppressed issues (March)
* Journalists dropping the ball yet again by focusing on responses to [Pentagon leaks](https://substack.com/redirect/38ea396f-1c31-4b16-b008-4d08b059b69c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) rather than the corruption, fraud, and waste that they revealed (April)
* A discussion of yet another [media failure enabling congressional corruption](https://substack.com/redirect/627036ee-8cc2-4bb7-8078-9a29bd074db5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), particularly in coverage of the seat for which I ran from 2018-2022 (September)
* A review of predictable [disinformation spread by Washington and Tel Aviv](https://substack.com/redirect/e484551b-91e6-4aea-a883-a8a3a8169225?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to enable the colonial aspirations of both Israeli and American officials (October)
* A [rare admission by journalists about the corruption of their own profession](https://substack.com/redirect/3378497a-d1c7-470e-8e2f-1f9efb2b6a37?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that barely scratched the surface (November)
* A remarkable story by the _New York Times_ representing [a newspaper of record showing up a decade late to cover concerns about police body cameras](https://substack.com/redirect/4a8a20d5-1c30-4bc9-879f-4881d1fd6bef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that I & other advocates published years go (December)

### **Climate Chaos**
* A [climate-change driven catastrophe](https://substack.com/redirect/aa52d7fa-66aa-4e23-a863-9f5e69f9bd0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that hit close to home, and the irony of its bizarrely apt name (8/23)
* An analysis of [the recent global climate agreement](https://substack.com/redirect/0f2adab5-457e-4292-882f-b3dbf57c0de8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) explaining why it might offer less promise than we all would wish (December)

### **U.S. History**
* The radical--and ironically [widely forgotten--history](https://substack.com/redirect/2f8b0022-6198-4c63-8ad9-ed46f136dd54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr., also released as a [podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/48881467-ab87-48ea-ae7f-412cbb6fcfa0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (January)
* A review of the tremendous life & legacy of military whistleblower and [international hero Daniel Ellsberg](https://substack.com/redirect/d5e7f0c9-dc9e-4a9d-b506-7da157611b1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (June)
* An analysis of [race relations in the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/d5c8fa1a-a210-4340-8d42-c2e84fad16ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the cosmetic recognition of Juneteenth as a federal holiday even as white supremacy continues to grow ever more deeply entrenched (June)
* A reflection on a national holiday through the eyes of [Black visionary Frederick Douglass](https://substack.com/redirect/1a0bbf38-a4b7-41d9-badd-8bed7aca1d4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (July)
* A reflection on the [legacy of the 9/11 attacks](https://substack.com/redirect/72431d1f-414a-4c19-9e50-cb62072dada4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over 20 years ago, and how they were co-opted by a military industrial establishment to entrench its corruption and unaccountable violence (September)
* A reminder, in the midst of the Israeli genocide in Gaza, that [American support for genocide](https://substack.com/redirect/20d5088b-3cfc-462e-91c2-d9180dc33e92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has been not only long established but also continued long after most Americans thought it ended (October)

* A [poem about a voyage](https://substack.com/redirect/5cfdba3f-203f-4de3-8ee1-8d17824c49ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that offered me vast insight as I worked to recover from loss (July)
* An [invitation to join me](https://substack.com/redirect/65c0febc-a8ca-4aba-9f71-13681b0a888e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on a nascent digital platform challenging major social media platforms (May)
* A [song about police violence](https://substack.com/redirect/1c1ed391-4f55-4f34-abb4-09b3fe6fa2d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from "Ferguson to Jerusalem" (November)
* A few reasons [why I remained grateful this year](https://substack.com/redirect/26fb7170-fef9-44a3-8ac0-446961153698?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), despite the escalating madness around the world (November)

### **An invitation**
I published eight articles in the month of November, largely because I had time in between my jobs working as a kayak guide and snowboard instructor while waiting for the weather to shift. Left to my own devices, I'd maintain a similar pace throughout the year--but the need to pay rent and put food on the table forced me to prioritize the jobs that pay my bills.

name: Matthew Lucci
subject: HUGE ENDORSEMENT for the New Year!
body:
Happy New Year!

I hope that you had the time to reflect on this past year, with all of the
ups and downs, successes and failures, and everything else.
Most importantly, I hope that you had the time to count your blessings and
thank God for His providence to get us through another year.

We can agree that things have been pretty bad - the economy, the border
crisis, drugs pouring into our communities, and human trafficking rampant
across our state. We can also agree that Congress (including Congressman
Roger Williams) has only made things worse - by raising the debt limit,
sending more of our hard-earned money to Ukraine, and refusing to impeach
Mayorkas.

[image: image.png]

Block Walking in Arlington with a Volunteer

you could spare a few dollars
<https://secure.winred.com/lucci-for-congress/donate-today> to help us

no-brainer," and that it's time for TX-25 to be represented by a true

Matthew Lucci endorsed by Julie McCarty, CEO of True Texas Project

body:
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76216510/446959800/-1729839915?amount=10&amounts=3,5,7,10&refcode=RRFC_20231231_EMSPL_E2_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDcvMS8xMDc4NzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzBmYjk1OGUtMWZhOC1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=159Yh_vUJrKy7HGA3vkDXrXSIYE89AXCRSkpH2H_-uc=) Friend,

There aren't many Republicans in Congress with records quite as extreme as Ken Calvert's.

_Democracy:_
No on certifying President Biden's victory in 2020

_LGBTQ issues:_
No on the Matthew Shepard & James Byrd Hate Crimes Prevention Act
No on recognizing gay marriage nationally, and sought to ban it in California
He publicly outed a former Democratic opponent

_Women’s rights:_
No on the right to Contraception Act No on the Violence Against Women Act
No on the Equal Rights Amendment
No on the Fair Pay Act

_Sensible gun laws:_
No on assault weapons ban
No on expanding background checks
No on the Protecting Our Kids Act
Yes to expand conceal and carry laws
Yes to protect firearms manufacturers from lawsuits

_The environment:_
No on the Inflation Reduction Act which made historic investments in clean energy
No on protecting people from toxic incinerators
No on recovering America’s wildlife
No on investing in transportation and water infrastructure
No on cracking down on oil company price gouging

body:
| | [](https://connect.expandlibertypac.com/r?u=xEaE4enJXWeAU2VA9SFyiroA8niGdH2TT0q5xTGZSRU&e=0de68e271d54d43c152f7e86d36df6df&utm_source=expandlibertypac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=expand_liberty_in_2024&n=1)
---
| Friend, The corporate press and establishment pundits complained nonstop in 2023 about the “do-nothing” Congress. If only we were so lucky. **The reality is that congressional leaders passed a lot of terrible, anti-liberty legislation in 2023, and they hope to pass even more in 2024!** They also did their customary year-end can-kicking, with both the House and Senate voting to extend current-level funding for some programs and agencies through January 19 and the rest through February 2, and voting to reauthorize Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA 702) through April 19. Congress reconvenes the second week of January, and **we don’t want you to be surprised when congressional leaders try to pull a fast one on the American people** by ramming through more federal spending and unconstitutional surveillance under the guise of bipartisan “compromise.” The speaker of the House and Senate majority leader understand well that these arbitrary congressional deadlines create an environment ripe for exploitation. Establishment politicians and lobbyists regularly use “must pass” bills to sneak through unrelated (and often controversial) provisions that likely couldn’t pass on their own – at least not without a lot of publicity, scrutiny, and criticism. **But we’ll be watching them closely and reporting back on all their schemes and plans.** We’ll be paying especially close attention to what happens with FISA 702. This notorious spying program – which in practice results in the vast collection and warrantless searches of Americans’ communications and other data – was set to expire at the end of 2023, but Congress extended it for four months by slipping its reauthorization into the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA). **That means early 2024 will likely include debate on whether and how to reform this surveillance program as part of a longer-term reauthorization of FISA 702.** We’ll have a lot more to say about the surveillance debate in the weeks ahead, but out of the bills currently in circulation, the most pro-liberty one by far is the **Government Surveillance Reform Act**([S. 3234](https://connect.expandlibertypac.com/r?u=VTmj4rzT2IGTecsX4bEyWFXr9B2jhBRrSrOhymPen871QSuw0zOo274g3MTj9OKnr9krJlfQqip0w2PKBh5-U2KiCLMjAi84wtnPFpHKAoI&e=0de68e271d54d43c152f7e86d36df6df&utm_source=expandlibertypac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=expand_liberty_in_2024&n=2)/[H.R. 6262](https://connect.expandlibertypac.com/r?u=VTmj4rzT2IGTecsX4bEyWFXr9B2jhBRrSrOhymPen86oWDVQSl9YdCkqAbhpfm721hZTpeOpEreibTgFyZn19UiC0n2jgVZQiQy53nSpXKc&e=0de68e271d54d43c152f7e86d36df6df&utm_source=expandlibertypac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=expand_liberty_in_2024&n=3)). **And there’s much more we’ll be watching** , from how Speaker Mike Johnson runs the House, to the Treasury Department’s attempts to expand its reporting and surveillance regime to thwart currency competition, to debates about free speech and Section 230 – not to mention how our elected officials are coming down on these issues. We’ll have our eyes on all of it. **But we can’t do it without the help and support of allies like you.** **Anything you can give – whether $25, $50, $100, $1,000, or more – means a lot and helps us do more to advocate pro-liberty policies and support pro-liberty candidates.** [**You can click here to donate now.**](https://connect.expandlibertypac.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_zSlWqY9dpM6gLkg5CtbiiR0fj1OOFjRedJkgulBBCzeyebnmDwRwTZpAUdyrW8YJAqdHmm3MQpyskiyB-WwmoM&e=0de68e271d54d43c152f7e86d36df6df&utm_source=expandlibertypac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=expand_liberty_in_2024&n=4) There’s a lot going on in 2024, but we’ll be ready. With your help, we’ll be the most active and effective source for the American people on the issues discussed above and more. Thanks so much for your support.
In liberty, The Team
Expand Liberty PAC
P.S. You can also help by volunteering your time and talents to our cause by signing up to [get involved here](https://connect.expandlibertypac.com/r?u=0J5d6UsHYTui5I2PvzUDdbQRDmSK_EA_LK2bvkKooqeU10AIuXmNXZP2ntMfEIJX&e=0de68e271d54d43c152f7e86d36df6df&utm_source=expandlibertypac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=expand_liberty_in_2024&n=5).

Hello,

Before the year officially ends, I wanted to reach out and tell you about what your grassroots support helped the NDRC accomplish in 2023, and the work we still have ahead of us.

This year, thanks to your support, we were incredibly successful in electing Democracy Defenders across the country.
* In **Wisconsin** and **Pennsylvania** , our Democracy Defenders defeated election deniers on the states’ highest courts.
* We elected 57 candidates to the **Virginia** state legislature, securing a Democratic majority in both chambers and flipping the House of Delegates.

We also saw sweeping victories for voters and voting rights advocates in the courts:
* In June, the U.S. Supreme Court affirmed a lower court’s decision that Alabama’s congressional map likely **violated Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act** in _Allen v. Milligan_ , opening the door to expand representation for voters in the state and across the country.
* In _Moore v. Harper_ , the U.S. Supreme Court also protected checks and balances by rejecting North Carolina Republicans’ attempt to advance the radical independent state legislature (ISL) theory; and protected fair maps enacted by independent commissions and state courts in places that were once heavily gerrymandered.

By continuing our efforts, we can lay the groundwork for many more wins in years to come, but we cannot let our opponents get away with unchecked gerrymandering. With your support, there is a real path to the 2024 elections taking place on maps that are even fairer than the maps we helped secure in 2022.

[**_Our movement has been fighting for fairness state by state – and we’re not stopping. If you’re able to, please consider making a donation to the NDRC to help power our movement through 2024 and beyond._**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76218027/446963173/1153222191?amount=30&refcode=EM_RTI_20231231_FR_12O_redlight922_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjNmNTA0M2E3LTIxYTgtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyMWY1NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Y2Y_CsYPdePL1_1klMbLoQV_Ajvy8xAKNdZ4T7zcfxY=) | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

Please — help me out.
| Y’all —

**This month our campaign faces our most important fundraising deadline of this campaign.**

The end of the year isn’t a time to set conservative goals — it’s when you _go big or go home._ We did the math, and we need another 6,932 individual donations over this month to start the election year off strong. The Voter Protection Project said I could reach out to you to see if you’re able to split a contribution between their team and mine before time runs out. | [SPLIT A DONATION »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/58848?t=6&akid=12244%2E878179%2EIltsPa)
---
Look, as a retired educator and state representative, I’m no stranger to tough fights. I’m taking on MAGA Senator Marsha Blackburn because she’s an extremist bully who represents only her donors, _NOT_ her constituents.

**I’ll say this as many times as it takes: Marsha is _wrong_ for Tennessee. But I won’t deny that she’s going to be a tough opponent to beat.**

Her corporate PAC backers know that as long as Marsha’s in the Senate, they can rest assured that she’ll vote in their interests. And the GOP knows that if they lose this seat, they have no chance at retaking the majority.

I can’t defeat them alone. I need you with me.

We’re building the kind of grassroots, multi-party, multi-ethnic, multi-generational coalition that Tennessee has never seen — because it’s the ONLY way we’ll overcome MAGA Marsha.

[_I can’t win without meeting my critical end-of-year goal before time runs out. Help me keep up this critical fight by pitching in anything you can afford right here, right now to my campaign and the Voter Protection Project »_](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/58848?t=7&akid=12244%2E878179%2EIltsPa)

Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom's commitment to the people of New Jersey has been inspired by a legacy of **dedicated public service** from his grandfather, former U.S. Representative Robert Kean, to his father, former Governor Thomas H. Kean Sr. Kean has always understood and recognized the importance of civic engagement and is honored to **represent the people of New Jersey's 7th Congressional District** in Congress. >From his early days in the Environmental Protection Agency during the George H.W. Bush Administration (where he met his incredible wife Rhonda), to serving as a volunteer firefighter and an emergency medical technician in Washington, D.C. — Tom has always had a heart for making our world a better, freer, safer place. Determined to answer the call to public service again, Tom Kean Jr. believed he, personally, could turn ideas into action and make a lasting difference in people’s lives. In 2001, Tom was elected to the New Jersey General Assembly, and two years later, was named to the upper house of the state legislature after his tireless work in ethics reform. Then in 2008, his peers unanimously elected him Republican Leader in the New Jersey Senate. Shortly thereafter, he unveiled his caucus’ job creation package, **“Common-Sense Plan for a More Affordable New Jersey,”** which ultimately reversed the course that previous administrations were quickly leading the state down. To this day, Tom continues to build upon his proven track record of delivering for the people of New Jersey in Congress:
* **Passed legislation advocating for Veteran-Owned small businesses**
* **Passed legislation to improve commuter rail transportation**
* **Passed a resolution affirming strong US support for Ukraine**
* **Passed legislation to support mental health for school children**

The 2024 election is less than a year away and there’s a lot at stake. There are many important races including attorney general, secretary of state, and treasurer, all statewide seats with four-year terms. It’s critical for the future of our state that we elect candidates to fill these seats who will be champions for our climate and environment.
We must also hold Senate Republicans who took part in this year’s walkout accountable on the ballot. It’s time that we end these anti-democratic tactics once and for all, and elect more climate champions to the legislature.
And with former President Trump likely to be on the ballot again this year, it’s a reminder that we can’t take elections for granted and our work at the state level is as important as ever.
As always, we’re going up against deep-pocketed corporate interests and fossil fuel companies. Our secret weapon is you—thousands of grassroots supporters coming together to support our work. **[Will you help us elect future climate and environmental champions by donating to the OLCV PAC today?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76222110/446970854/913998683?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFmY2VmYjE5LTI4YTgtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyMWY1NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=X-ctZXBcTMjHhtIl49Aqzl9W5pD5WiSiOWyMDbgUgiM=&emci=b20e97cd-25a8-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&emdi=afcefb19-28a8-ee11-bea1-002248221f54&ceid=2107230)**
Wishing you a happy new year on behalf of all of us at OLCV.

There are many important races including attorney general, secretary of state, and treasurer, all statewide seats with four-year terms. It’s critical for the future of our state that we elect candidates to fill these seats who will be champions for our climate and environment. We must also hold Senate Republicans who took part in this year’s walkout accountable on the ballot. It’s time that we end these anti-democratic tactics once and for all, and elect more climate champions to the legislature. And with former President Trump likely to be on the ballot again this year, it’s a reminder that we can’t take elections for granted and our work at the state level is as important as ever. As always, we’re going up against deep-pocketed corporate interests and fossil fuel companies. Our secret weapon is you—thousands of grassroots supporters coming together to support our work. ---
| | Hi Friend,

As the final seconds of the year tick away, we're not just welcoming a new year; we're revving up for an epic showdown in our quest to reshape CA-34. The clock is ticking, and our fundraising sprint is hitting its most critical phase. We're on the brink of igniting a transformative wave across our district, a wave that can only surge forward with your invaluable support.

Let's take a moment to reflect on where we've been. CA-34, a district rich in diversity and potential, has seen its share of challenges. Leadership in the past has been a mixed bag - some steps forward, but many missed opportunities. Our community deserves better. We've witnessed the need for more robust advocacy, greater accessibility, and a leadership that truly echoes the voices of its people.
---
|
---
---
| Now, it's time to pivot to our vision for 2024. With your backing, we're poised to champion a bold new agenda. We're talking about ramping up our fight for justice, amplifying equality, and ensuring that every voice in CA-34 is not just heard, but is a driving force in the decisions that shape our lives.
---
|
---
---
| Your contribution, not corporate PAC money, is the fuel that powers our movement. No matter the size of the donation, your support is the catalyst that will help us shatter the status quo and bring about the change we all yearn for. This is our moment to rally together, to pool our strengths, and to march into 2024 with the resources, resolve, and resilience to make history.

Thank you for standing with us, for believing in this cause, and for being an integral part of this pivotal journey. Together, we will redefine the future of CA-34 and blaze a trail of progress that will echo for generations to come.

Happy New Year! Let's win this!

Recently, Congress approved a record-breaking $886 billion military budget to fund bombs, weapons, and war crimes.
I voted against this massively wasteful budget for war and destruction, which was the largest military budget in the history of our country. This budget is impossible to justify when our neighbors are struggling to put food on the table, fighting to keep a roof over their heads, and rationing their medication.
We must divest from endless war and death. My residents sent me to Congress to invest in life. I will continue to advocate for marginalized communities and working families, for peace and diplomacy, and for freedom and dignity for all people.

name: Team Daniels
subject: The Last One
body:
Dear Friend,
In just a few short hours, we will all turn the page on 2023 and look forward to the year ahead. We wanted to make sure you didn’t miss the important New Year’s message from Shamaine (below), and we wanted to ask for your support one more time.
Before the clock strikes midnight and we celebrate with friends and family, please make a contribution to support our campaign and help us reach our online fundraising goal!
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
As we all ponder our hopes for the year ahead, all of us at Team Daniels wish you and yours a happy, healthy and prosperous 2024. Together we will achieve our shared goal of defeating insurrectionist Congressman Scott Perry!
Thank you for all of your support in 2023 and Happy New Year!
- Team Daniels
Begin Forwarded Message . . .
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Dear Friend,
I hope this message finds you and your family housed and in great health. As this year comes to a close, I can’t help but reflect on my professional and personal accomplishments in 2023. To be honest, I expected life to be a little calmer than it was in 2022 and frankly, a bit slower as we geared up for our campaign in 2024.
As I look back, there is one photo that I think best captures my personal and professional successes in 2023. It’s a photo of my daughter enjoying a babyccino (there is no coffee) at Elementary Coffee in Harrisburg, PA during a strategy meeting for my campaign. What you can’t tell is that she was just as present as everyone else during the intense discussions about AI use in campaigning. In fact, I remember noticing how having a toddler interrupt conversations to introduce “rabbit” to an AI software engineer and the founders of a new tech startup didn’t derail anyone from doing their jobs.
That ability to focus on the work that needs to get done has increasingly become one of my measures of the competence of the partners I work with and those I want to represent me. While working on some of the most cutting-edge technology of our lifetimes, the group I was meeting with was fully capable of being nurturing to my daughter while having in-depth conversations about tech, policy and values. I think that is simultaneously what is amazing about this story, and what we should expect from our public servants.
I didn’t know at the start of 2023 that I would be making campaign world history [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/12/12/democratic-campaign-ai-caller-00131180] , With that history-making moment came a lot of hours of hard work and focus. Let’s just say that I ended 2023 ready for a nap. As the year comes to a close–and I take my nap–I cannot wait to get to work in 2024 and finish what we started by defeating Scott Perry in November.
I close 2023 grateful for all that we’ve done. As I head into 2024, there is a world I wish for my daughter –and all of you–in 2024. I wish for:
Peace on earth!
Healthy food for our families
Habitable and loving housing
Clean air and water
The ability to make decisions over our own bodies and healthcare.
Time for leisure and fitness
...and of course, more naps, lots of naps.
With 2024 just hours away, will you make a contribution to our campaign to help us reach our online fundraising goal before midnight tonight? CLICK HERE to DONATE NOW! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Happy New Year!
With gratitude,
Shamaine

Friend,

If you didn’t know, I am the Democrat taking on Congresswoman Lauren Boebert after she announced that she's moving to run in my district (CO-04).

Currently Lauren Boebert has $2,000,000 dollars in the bank with more on the way, while it wasn’t enough for her to cut it in her old district where her opponent raised $10 million, it is more than enough for her to pack a punch in her new district.

Her hope is that she can pull a fast one and dominate this often-overlooked district with her millions and leave democrats in the dust. **We won’t let this happen.

** As you can imagine, our chief priority right now is fundraising. Over the past three days since Boebert’s announcement we have raised over **$164,000 dollars** from more than **5,530 donors**.

We are making enormous strides towards catching up to her but we need to close out our end of quarter as strong as possible and get to $175,000 _by midnight_ if we want to stay on pace to catch up to her by the middle of next quarter.

| | Hello Peter,

New Year’s Eve is a chance to think about everything that has led us to this point and the opportunity to consider what is to come.

As Executive Director for the GA Dems, I would be remiss to not recall the past successes that we have achieved, transforming Georgia from a red stronghold into a premiere battleground and one of only 6 states that will determine who sits in the Oval Office in January 2025.

Of course, there were the remarkable successes that we achieved in 2020, 2021, and 2022. We made history flipping Georgia blue for Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, electing Senators Reverend Raphael Warnock and Jon Ossoff, and _**then_** re-electing Rev. Warnock last November.

And the truth is, those successes weren’t flukes – they happened thanks to commitments from activists, donors, and grassroots supporters who worked tirelessly to accomplish huge goals. We worked ceaselessly for years to bring about change in Georgia, and right now, we’re on the edge of even greater success.

**Next year, we will keep Georgia blue and stop Donald Trump from returning to the White House._And I want you with us._**

[**_Please, pitch in right now, before the year ends, to support our work throughout 2024 and beyond.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76227259/446986159/710125701?refcode=20231231.2_KO_12AT&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZWIxYjRjOS0zNGE4LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjFmNTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GVDN0Rz5_WvAC10BDt_8fM6QztiMUKjn6xw3VQ757ZY=)**_

Let’s ring in the new year together,

Kevin

Tolulope Kevin Olasanoye
Executive Director
Democratic Party of Georgia

Hi friend – Happy (almost) New Year!

I know I’ve been reaching out a lot ahead of tonight’s critical end-of-quarter deadline, but this is my last message to you before the new year.

I just got off the phone with my Campaign Manager, Blakely, and found out that we’re still $1,208 short of tonight’s end-of-quarter goal. **I know that seems like a lot, but if even just half of the people reading this email chipped in $1, we’d catch up before midnight.**

So please, before you head out to celebrate the new year, will you chip in a few dollars to our campaign? [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bynumq42023?refcode=EndofYearDeadline**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76227452/446986750/476240636?refcode=em_fr_2023.12.31_b1_jbp_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjZjMTI4NTYtMzVhOC1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIxZjU0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=wAfJ3MEM-ob0bmsqtjlI_fNeZTI8hFuIUHHTbXOvq0U=)

Thank you so much... and Happy New Year!

Janelle

| | Friend, My name is Clara Gaitan, and I was so proud of my son Alex when he graduated from the police academy. But our dream of Alex serving as a police officer has become our family’s nightmare. **_Alex is facing 99 years in prison for catching a dangerous criminal!_** As a mother, I’m beside myself. You won’t believe how this miscarriage of justice came about. Back in March 2021, Alex was dispatched for an unknown urgent call for service. When Alex arrived at the address, he recognized he’d been there before on previous calls. The first time Alex had been there, he had to fight an inhumanly strong young man who was a drug user. Even with two other officers, it was nearly impossible to subdue the suspect. Only a non-lethal Taser worked, but not before the suspect injured an officer. However, on this day, **THREE** other officers had been dispatched to the scene, so they had a better chance of subduing the suspect. When Alex caught up with his fellow officers, he saw all three officers on the ground, struggling to bring the suspect under control. Alex told him to stop resisting, then grabbed his upper torso and put him on the ground. **Even on the ground with****FOUR AGAINST ONE****, the suspect had inhuman strength, as if he were on drugs.** Alex knew the suspect’s pain tolerance was so high that fist strikes would not work and could injure Alex. So Alex followed his training and used his police-issued baton to get the suspect to comply and lie fully on the ground. While on the ground, the suspect continued to resist the officers and their attempts to get him in handcuffs. So Alex decided to use his non-lethal Taser to get the suspect’s compliance. The Taser deployment worked, and the suspect stopped resisting the police officers. The danger was over, and Alex would come home that night. The possibility of your loved one not surviving their shift is a reality that every police family lives with, especially today when criminals are willing to fight officers. So we thought that was the end of it... **_but we were wrong._** Almost two years later, the local anti-cop, socialist District Attorney dropped a bombshell and indicted Alex for aggravated assault... ...even though it was the suspect who resisted arrest and decided it was a good idea to fight four police officers. Alex could be imprisoned for up to **99 years** if convicted. **_That’s outrageous!_** The good news is Alex has the moral support of his department, his Chief of Police, and hundreds of his Brothers and Sisters in Blue across the country. But, Friend, as you well know, cops don’t get paid a ton for the sacrifices they make and the dangers they put themselves in to keep us all safe. As a result of these attacks on my son, we’re facing a mountain of legal bills that could bury us — and send Alex to prison for up to 99 years! So when Jim Fotis and the National Center for Police Defense (NCPD), a 501(c)3 non-profit charity, offered to help us, it was like God was answering our prayers.
---
[](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jkFPxCAQhX8NvdHQgcL2wEHd1IOJd0-GMoOLKUuXsln7700bYzKneV_e-1xa5hg2y8wzA7hEXBkAk08M4PbxSOX-nd5e-Xbu-E2_p34P4YUB1G2hf_KvpKXk4rx_zblBKwMK1ZDtjFBC62EwzcUabxSECQiVUgF88HoI_dSTRG-mk2miBQGyO67XcGpPQnkUwajBoHHSMSWOndYlKtG7bq0PV0rOqfU5NbO91Lqsh9jIYFzJ3wu17kqY604wGK9-QQYjTrwCckpcaU4_lclxzffi6dNnJCbPOPEd5ZSUnrgA1RSLyyPOc1y1YUp8HSI-p98AAAD__2wHY1k)
---
Founded by Jim Fotis, an Army veteran and retired police officer from New York, the NCPD has been instrumental in taking the lead to stand up for police officers Sheriff Joe Arpaio (“America’s Toughest Sheriff”), Tulsa’s Police Officer Betty Shelby, New York Cops Anthony Federico and Hugh Barry Jr., Michigan’s Mark Bessner, and many more. The NCPD is a 100% hard-hitting organization of police officers (retired and active) and defense attorneys who know what Alex has been through and what it takes to see his case to victory. Friend, now that you know that Alex is being railroaded for safely subduing a dangerous suspect, let me ask you point blank: **[Will you help Alex today by making a tax-deductible gift of $10, $15, $20, $25 or more to the NCPD to help them fund Alex’s defense?](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jkFPxCAQhX8NvdHQgcL2wEHd1IOJd0-GMoOLKUuXsln7700bYzKneV_e-1xa5hg2y8wzA7hEXBkAk08M4PbxSOX-nd5e-Xbu-E2_p34P4YUB1G2hf_KvpKXk4rx_zblBKwMK1ZDtjFBC62EwzcUabxSECQiVUgF88HoI_dSTRG-mk2miBQGyO67XcGpPQnkUwajBoHHSMSWOndYlKtG7bq0PV0rOqfU5NbO91Lqsh9jIYFzJ3wu17kqY604wGK9-QQYjTrwCckpcaU4_lclxzffi6dNnJCbPOPEd5ZSUnrgA1RSLyyPOc1y1YUp8HSI-p98AAAD__2wHY1k) ** Alex’s legal defense will cost over $150,000, and he doesn’t have the money to pay for it. _Alex needs your help!_ Make no mistake, a shameful pattern of anti-police sentiment and cop-hating rhetoric has swept America over the past decade. Alex’s exoneration at trial is critical to restoring the integrity of policing in America. This “war on cops” is not a joke. It’s for real. And now, they’re coming after my Alex. **[Please, as the loving mother of an honorable and honest cop, I beg you to lend us a hand by donating $10, $15, $20, $25 or even $50 or $100 today.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jkFPxCAQhX8NvdHQgcL2wEHd1IOJd0-GMoOLKUuXsln7700bYzKneV_e-1xa5hg2y8wzA7hEXBkAk08M4PbxSOX-nd5e-Xbu-E2_p34P4YUB1G2hf_KvpKXk4rx_zblBKwMK1ZDtjFBC62EwzcUabxSECQiVUgF88HoI_dSTRG-mk2miBQGyO67XcGpPQnkUwajBoHHSMSWOndYlKtG7bq0PV0rOqfU5NbO91Lqsh9jIYFzJ3wu17kqY604wGK9-QQYjTrwCckpcaU4_lclxzffi6dNnJCbPOPEd5ZSUnrgA1RSLyyPOc1y1YUp8HSI-p98AAAD__2wHY1k) ** From the bottom of my heart, and on behalf of my son Alex and all law enforcement personnel and their families, I thank you. With gratitude,

Clara Gaitan P.S. Alex is the kindest, bravest, most honest police officer you could ever meet. He is the joy of our family and a highly respected member of the law enforcement community.
**[Please help my family prove his innocence by supporting his legal defense with your generous, 100% tax-deductible donation of $10, $15, $20, $25, $50, $100 or more to the National Center for Police Defense today.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jkFPxCAQhX8NvdHQgcL2wEHd1IOJd0-GMoOLKUuXsln7700bYzKneV_e-1xa5hg2y8wzA7hEXBkAk08M4PbxSOX-nd5e-Xbu-E2_p34P4YUB1G2hf_KvpKXk4rx_zblBKwMK1ZDtjFBC62EwzcUabxSECQiVUgF88HoI_dSTRG-mk2miBQGyO67XcGpPQnkUwajBoHHSMSWOndYlKtG7bq0PV0rOqfU5NbO91Lqsh9jIYFzJ3wu17kqY604wGK9-QQYjTrwCckpcaU4_lclxzffi6dNnJCbPOPEd5ZSUnrgA1RSLyyPOc1y1YUp8HSI-p98AAAD__2wHY1k)** I pray you will do your best, as Alex has always done as a son and a police officer.

The corporate-controlled media has done everything they can to stop Bobby, and still, he surges in the polls. | | Peter,

There were big victories for reproductive freedom and democracy in Wisconsin this month.

On December 5, a Dane County Circuit Court judge issued a decision declaring that abortion is not prohibited by the Wisconsin law dating back to the mid-1800s that a number of people have understood to be a restrictive abortion ban.

On December 22, the Wisconsin Supreme Court issued an opinion requiring Wisconsin’s current state legislative maps to be replaced with new maps.

I’m proud to be standing up for reproductive freedom and democracy in Wisconsin. And I’m looking forward to continuing to work to make progress on important issues in the year ahead.
